qe: Which plastic is used for making 'Disposable' syringes in hospitals?
qh: अस्पतालों में 'डिस्पोजेबल' सिरिंज बनाने के लिए किस प्लास्टिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Disposable syringes ke liye polypropylene (PP) plastic chuna jaata hai kyunki ise autoclave (bhaap) se aasaani se jaraamusht (sterilise) kiya ja sakta hai, ye rasayanik padaarthon ko sahta hai, sasta hai aur aasaani se moulded roop mein dhalta hai. Polyester kapde aur bottle mein, PVC pipe aur wire insulation mein aur Bakelite switch-board jaisi thermosetting cheezon mein istemal hota hai - isliye wo syringe ke liye sahi nahi hain. Yaad rakhein ki PP ek thermoplastic hai jise baar-baar garam karke dhaal aakar diya ja sakta hai, isliye hospital ke ek-baar-istemal (single-use) saadhanon mein iska istemal sabse zyada hai. Exam point: disposable syringes = polypropylene (PP); sterilise hone ki khamta aur sasta-mouldable hona iska karan hai.

qe: What is 'ABS' plastic commonly used for?
qh: 'ABS' प्लास्टिक का सामान्यतः किसमें उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: ABS ka poora naam acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene hai - ye teen aadhaar (monomer) se bana terpolimer hai jo kathor (hard), mazboot aur jhatka-rook (impact resistant) hota hai, isliye LEGO bricks, computer-tv ke case, helmet aur khilone isse bante hain. Ye ek thermoplastic hai, isliye ise pighla kar naya aakar diya ja sakta hai. Kapde, khana lapetne ya bag banane ke liye alag plastics istemal hote hain (kapde polyester-nylon se, khana lapetne ke liye PE/PP, bag ke liye poly bag) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: ABS (acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene) = mazboot, jhatka-rook thermoplastic, LEGO bricks aur computer cases ke liye mashhoor.

qe: Which chemical is used to 'Preserve' wooden furniture from termites?
qh: दीमक से लकड़ी के फर्नीचर को सुरक्षित रखने के लिए किस रसायन का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Lakdi ke saamaan ko deemak (termite) aur nami se bachane ke liye kreosot tel (creosote oil) ya koyla-tar (coal tar) lagaya jaata hai - ismein phenols aur tar acid hote hain jo jeevon ko lakdi khaane se rok dete hain; railway sleepers aur khambon ko bachane mein bhi yahi istemal hota hai. Paani, wax aur saadharan paint se deemak nahi rukti (paint sirf upari satah banata hai, andar tak asar nahi karta), Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: lakdi ko deemak se bachane ke liye kreosote oil / coal tar ka lep (preservative) istemal hota hai - ismein phenol jaisa jeevan-nashak gun hota hai.

qe: What is 'Gutta-percha'?
qh: 'गट्टा-पर्चा' (Gutta-percha) क्या है?
o: Natural isomer of rubber used for dental fillings
e: Gutta-percha prakritik rabar (natural rubber) ka ek vibhramak (isomer) hai - dono ka rasayanik formula saman hota hai (polyisoprene) par gutta-percha 'trans' aakar ka hai aur rabar 'cis' aakar ka, isliye gutta-percha kathor aur kam lochdar (less elastic) hota hai. Yahi gun ise daanton ki bharai (dental filling), root canal aadi mein upyogi banata hai; golf ki gend aur cable insulation mein bhi iska istemal hua karta tha. Ye fiber, synthetic rubber ya glue nahi hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: gutta-percha = prakritik rabar ka trans-isomer (polyisoprene), kathor aur kam lochdar; dant chikitsa (dental filling) mein istemal hota hai.

qe: Which 'Detergent' is used for washing delicate woolens (Liquid detergent)?
qh: नाजुक ऊनी कपड़ों की धुलाई के लिए किस प्रकार के डिटर्जेंट का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Bina aayanik (non-ionic) detergents halke (mild) hote hain aur paani mein aayan nahi banate, isliye ye oon (wool), resham jaise nazuk kapdon ki sabse achhi safai karte hain - inka pH lagbhag udasin hota hai jisse oon ke protein fiber kharab nahi hote. Kationik detergents aam taur par hair-conditioner aur keetanu-nashak (germicide) ke roop mein, aayanik (anionic) detergents saadharan dhulai ke powder mein, aur saabun kam prabhavi hota hai sakht (hard) paani mein (jin pathar bante hain) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Yaad rakhein: dhulai ke liye non-ionic + liquid form nazuk kapdon ke liye best hai. Exam point: oon-resham ke nazuk kapdon ke liye non-ionic (neutral pH wala) liquid detergent; aayanik/anionic detergent aam dhulai ke liye hote hain.

qe: What is the 'Backbone' of most synthetic polymers?
qh: अधिकांश सिंथेटिक बहुलकों की 'रीढ़' (Backbone) किस तत्व की श्रृंखला होती है?
e: Lagbhag sabhi sanshleshit polymeron (synthetic polymers, jaise polyethylene, PVC, nylon, bakelite) ki reedh (backbone) carbon atoms ki shrankhala se banti hai, kyunki carbon ke chaar bandhan banane ki khamta se lambi-shakha rahit chain ban jaati hai. Kuchh khaas polymers (silicon-based silicon rubber, polysiloxane) mein silicon chain bhi hoti hai, par 'adhiktar' polymer ka dhancha carbon ka hi hota hai. Oxygen, silicon ya nitrogen chain wale vikalp samanya kathan nahi hain, kyunki ye keval khaas ghatak ke roop mein aate hain. Exam point: sanshleshit polymeron ki mukhya reedh carbon ki chain hoti hai (C-C bandhan se), isliye organic polymer carbon ke chaar bandhan par khade hote hain.

qe: Which chemical is used to 'Weight' silk and make it feel heavier?
qh: रेशम के कपड़े को भारी और घना महसूस कराने (वेटिंग) के लिए किस रसायन का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Resham (silk) ko bhaari (weighted) banane ke liye usme tin (tin) ya sisa (lead) ke lavan - jaise tin chloride - ka lep (treatment) diya jaata hai, jisse kapde mein giraavat aati hai aur mahnga mehsoos hota hai (aaj ye tareeka seh-hatya-hanikarak maan kar pratibandhit hai). Starch, sugar ya salt lagane se weight to thoda badh sakta hai par wo resham ke poshak (fabric) ke saath milte nahi aur dhulai par nikal jaate hain, Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: resham ko bhaari karne ke liye tin ya lead (sisa) ke lavan istemal kiye jaate the; ye tareeka aaj seh-suraksha ke karan pratibandhit kiya gaya hai.

qe: What is 'Vulc-leather' (Vulcanized fiber)?
qh: 'वल्क-लेदर' (वल्कनीकृत फाइबर) क्या है?
e: Vulcanised fibre (Vulcan-leather) kagaz ya cellulose wali patli chadar ko zinc chloride ke gaadhe ghulaimaan se upcharit karke banai jaati hai - zinc chloride cellulose ke fiberon ko khaas tarike se fula-phaila deta hai aur ek kathor, chamki-dar (leather-jaisa) padarth ban jaata hai, jise trailer-take, suitcases aur helmet ke andar ke astar mein istemal karte hain. Ye plastic, kuprat leather ya jaanvar ki khaal nahi hai - Ye vikalp galat hain, kyunki iska aadhar cherab (paper) hai aur upcharak zinc chloride hai. Exam point: Vulcan-leather (vulcanised fibre) = zin-chloride se upcharit kagaz/cellulose, kathor aur chamki-dar; suitcase aur helmet ke astar mein istemal hota hai.

qe: Which metal ion is 'Removed' when hard water is softened using a Zeolite?
qh: जिओलाइट विधि द्वारा कठोर जल को मृदु बनाते समय कौन से धातु आयन हटाए जाते हैं?
e: Zeolite (permutit) sakht (hard) paani ke calcium aur magnesium ionon ko ion-vinimay (ion exchange) ki vidhi se hata deta hai - iska sodium ion (Na+) paani ke calcium/magnesium (Ca2+/Mg2+) se badal jaata hai, isliye paani se chalni (hardness) ke liye zimmedar calcium nikal jaata hai aur paani narm (soft) ban jaata hai. Potassium aur chloride paani mein rehte hain, aur sodium to zeolite se nikal kar paani mein aata hai (isliye sodium 'hataaya' nahi jaata) - ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Isi ion-vinimay ke karan zeolite ko baar-baar namak ke ghulaimaan se dhokar phir istemal kar sakte hain. Exam point: zeolite se sakht paani se calcium (aur magnesium) ion hataaye jaate hain ion-exchange se; zeolite ke Na+ paani ke Ca2+ se badal jaate hain.

qe: What is 'Epoxy Resin' used for?
qh: 'एपॉक्सी रेजिन' का मुख्य उपयोग क्या है?
e: Epoxy resin ek do-ghatak (two-part) thermosetting padarth hai jo milne ke baad bahut mazboot bandh banata hai aur pani-rasayan se bachaav deta hai, isliye iska istemal mazboot chipkane wale glue (adhhesive), satah-lep (coating), electronics ke sealing aur floor-covering mein hota hai. Ise safai, indhan ya kapde banane mein istemal nahi karte, kyunki ye ek chipkane wala resin hai jo kathor ban jaata hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Iska naam 'epoxy' us epoxy group se aaya hai jo resin ke bante samay kriya karta hai. Exam point: epoxy resin = do-ghatak thermosetting resin, sabse mazboot chipkane (adhesive) aur bachav-coating ke liye; ismein resin aur hardener milkar sakht dhancha banate hain.

qe: Which polymer is used for making 'Raincoats'?
qh: 'रेनकोट' (बरसाती) बनाने के लिए किस बहुलक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Raincoat ke kapde ke liye PVC (polyvinyl chloride) ya polyurethane ki patli parat chadhi (coated) poshak istemal hoti hai, kyunki ye parat paani ko andar nahi jaane deti aur lachila-pan bhi banaye rakhti hai. Oon, cotton aur resham prakritik fibers hain jo paani sokh lete hain (hygroscopic) aur bheeg jaate hain, isliye raincoat ke liye anupukt hain. Isi tarah tarpaulin aur shopping-bag mein bhi PVC-coated kapda istemal hota hai. Exam point: raincoat = PVC ya polyurethane (PU) se coated kapda, kyunki ye jal-rodhak (waterproof) parat deta hai; cotton-wool-silk paani sokh lete hain isliye raincoat ke liye sahi nahi.

qe: What is 'Cellophane' made from?
qh: 'सेलोफेन' (Cellophane) किससे बनता है?
e: Cellophane cellulose (lakdi ke goode ka main ghatak) se banne wala paardarshi (transparent) patala padarth hai - ismein cellulose ko kshar aur carbon disulfide se kriya kara kar viskose banaya jaata hai, phir use patli chadar mein badal kar aint (acid) se jamaaya jaata hai (xanthate/viscose process). Ye protein, starch ya petroleum se nahi banta, kyunki iska kachcha maal cellulose hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Cellophane khana lapetne aur mitai ke dabbe mein istemal hota hai, par iska paani-rodhak gun badhane ke liye us par lak (wax) ya plastic ki patli parat bhi chadhai jaati hai. Exam point: cellophane = punarjivit (regenerated) cellulose se bani paardarshi patli chadar (viscose/xanthate process); kachcha maal lakdi ka cellulose hai.

qe: Which chemical is added to 'Soap' to make it 'Transparent'?
qh: साबुन को 'पारदर्शी' (Transparent) बनाने के लिए उसमें क्या मिलाया जाता है?
e: Saadharan saabun dhundhla (opaque) hota hai; use paardarshi (transparent) banane ke liye usmein glycerol ya ethanol (ya sugar solution) milaya jaata hai, jo saabun ke kasaav ko todta hai aur roshni ko aar-paar jaane deta hai. Namak milane se saabun jama hota hai (salting out) par padarth saaf-paardarshi nahi banta, chuna aur sugar kuchh anya uddeshyon ke liye istemal hote hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi karan vishishth (transparent) saabun mahnga hota hai aur chamakdar dikhta hai. Exam point: saabun ko transparent banane ke liye glycerol ya ethanol milaya jaata hai; namak sirf saabun ko ghulaimaan se alag (salting out) karne ke liye daala jaata hai.

qe: Which type of 'Glass' is used in making lenses for sunglasses because it absorbs Ultraviolet (UV) rays?
qh: धूप के चश्मों के लेंस बनाने में किस प्रकार के कांच का उपयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि यह पराबैंगनी किरणों को सोखता है?
e: Crookes glass (ya UV-absorbing glass) mein cerium oxide jaisa padaarth mila hota hai jo paraben (ultraviolet) kirnon ko sokh leta hai, isliye ise dhoop ke chashme (sunglasses) ke lens mein istemal karte hain. Pyrex borosil (borosilicate) kaanch hai jo garmi sahta hai, soda glass saadharan kaanch hai aur flint glass mein sisa (lead) hota hai jo roshni ka apvartan adhik karta hai - isliye ye teeno UV rokne ke liye theek nahi hain. Yaad rakhein: UV kirnein aankh aur twacha ko nuksan pahunchati hain, isliye dhoop ke lens ko UV-sokhak (absorbing) banana zaroori hota hai. Exam point: UV kirnein sokhne wala kaanch = Crookes glass (cerium oxide wala); iska istemal dhoop ke chashme ke lens mein hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Main Constituent' of Safety Match head?
qh: माचिस की तीली के सिरे (हेड) पर मुख्य घटक क्या होता है?
e: Safety match ki teeli ke sire (head) mein potassium chlorate (okseedak) aur antimony trisulfide (indhan) hota hai, aur teeli ki tikdi (box) ke kinare par laal phosphorus (red phosphorus) aur kaanch ka churn hota hai - ragadne par laal phosphorus se thodi urja badal kar chlorate ko todti hai aur tez anch lagti hai. 'Laal phosphorus' box ke kinare par hota hai, sulfur aur safed phosphorus purane-anupukt aur khatarnak matchon se jude hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: pehle safed (white) phosphorus wale match khatarnak the, isliye surakshit match mein unhe laal phosphorus se badla gaya. Exam point: safety match head = potassium chlorate + antimony trisulfide; ragadne wala laal phosphorus match-box ke kinare par hota hai.

qe: Which 'Dye' was the first synthetic dye ever discovered (by William Perkin)?
qh: विलियम पर्किन द्वारा खोजी गई दुनिया की पहली सिंथेटिक डाई कौन सी थी?
e: Pehla sanshleshit (synthetic) rang (dye) mauveine (aniline purple) tha, jise 1856 mein William Henry Perkin ne anilin se banaya tha - ye ek durghatna (accident) se bana aur isne vastra-udyog mein kraanti la di. Methyl orange indicator hai, indigo aur alizarin prakrutik (natural) rang hain jo indigo plant aur madder root se milte hain (alizarin ko baad mein sanshleshit roop mein bhi banaya gaya, par wo pehla dye nahi tha) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi khoj ke baad dye-udyog (Germany-Britain) tezi se badha. Exam point: pehla synthetic dye = mauveine (aniline purple), William Perkin, 1856, anilin se bana; indigo aur alizarin prakrutik rang hain.

qe: What is 'Lead Crystal' glass used for?
qh: 'लेड क्रिस्टल' कांच का उपयोग किसलिए किया जाता है?
e: Lead crystal kaanch mein sisa oksaid (lead oxide, 24% se adhik) mila hota hai, jisse kaanch mein roshni ka apvartan (refractive index) aur rangeen bikhraav (dispersion) kaafi badh jaata hai - isliye ye bahut chamakdar aur aawaz (ring) wala hota hai, aur iska istemal sajaavat ke gilas (decanters), jhaad-phanoos aur mehngi glassware mein hota hai. Lekin sisa hote hone ke karan ye laboratory ke beaker ya khane pakane ke bartan ke liye upyukt nahi (sisa khane mein jaa sakta hai) aur window glass ke liye bhi ye mahnga aur bhaari hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: lead crystal glass = sisa oksaid wala kaanch, adhik apvartan-ank (chamak aur ring) ke karan sajaavat ke glassware (decanters) mein istemal hota hai.

qe: Which chemical is used as a 'Developer' in black and white film processing?
qh: ब्लैक एंड व्हाइट फोटोग्राफी में 'डेवलपर' के रूप में किस रसायन का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Black and white film ko develop karne ke liye hydroquinone jaisa reducing (apchayak) padaarth istemal hota hai - ye roshni se bane 'chhipe chitra' wale silver ionon ko dhatu roop silver mein badal deta hai, jisse badal (image) dikhta hai. Acetic acid 'stop bath' hota hai jo developer ki kriya rok deta hai, sodium thiosulfate 'fixer' (hypo) hota hai jo bacha hua silver halide hatata hai, aur silver nitrate film par pehle se lagi hoti hai (developer nahi hai) - isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Isi tarah 'developer' ke baad stop bath, fixer aur dhulai ka kram hota hai. Exam point: film ka developer = hydroquinone (apchayak/reducing agent); stop bath acetic acid aur fixer sodium thiosulfate (hypo) hota hai.

qe: What is 'Graphene'?
qh: 'ग्राफीन' (Graphene) क्या है?
o: A single layer of carbon atoms in a hexagonal lattice
e: Graphene carbon ke atomon ki keval ek-ek parat (single layer) hai jismein atom honycomb (hexagonal) jaali ke roop mein jude hote hain - isi karan ye duniya ka sabse patla, sabse mazboot aur bijli-garmi ka sabse achha chaalak maana jaata hai. Ise 2004 mein Novoselov aur Geim ne alag kiya tha, jiske liye unhe Nobel puraskar mila. Graphene plastic, dhatu-mishran (alloy) ya drav indhan nahi hai - Ye vikalp galat hain; dhyan rakhein ki graphite (pencil lead) aisi hi kai paraton ka dher hota hai, aur graphene uski ek parat hai. Exam point: graphene = carbon atomon ki ek parat, hexagonal jaali; sabse patla aur sabse mazboot chaalak (2004, Nobel 2010).

qe: Which substance is used to 'Clarify' muddy water in rural areas by coagulation?
qh: गंदले पानी को साफ करने के लिए स्कंदन (coagulation) हेतु किस पदार्थ का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Gaadle (muddy) paani ko saaf karne ke liye alum (fitkari) daala jaata hai - ye paani mein ghulkar aise chhikne (floc) banata hai jo mail ke chhote kanon ko apne saath jod leta hai aur bhaari hokar neeche baith jaata hai; is kriya ko sanyojan (coagulation) kehte hain. Sirka, namak ya bleaching powder se gandla-pan is tarah nahi hat-ta - sirka aur namak is kaam ke liye kamzor hain aur bleaching powder jeevan-nashak (disinfectant) hai par mail bithane (settle) mein alum jitna prabhavi nahi. Exam point: gaadle paani ko saaf karne ke liye alum (fitkari) se sanyojan (coagulation) kiya jaata hai; alum ke chhikne mail ke kanon ko bhaari karke neeche bitha dete hain.

qe: What is 'Bakelite'?
qh: 'बेकेलाइट' किस प्रकार का बहुलक है?
e: Bakelite ek 'thermosetting' plastic hai jo phenol aur formaldehyde ki kriya se banta hai - ise ek baar aakar dene ke baad garam karne par bhi ye dobara nahi pighalta (uska jaali-dhancha permanent ho jaata hai), isliye ye swich-board, bijli ke plug, bartan ke handle aur telephone jaise garmi-sahne wale saamaanon mein istemal hota hai. Thermoplastics (jaise polythene, PVC) garam karne par pighal jaate hain, natural rubber aur fiber Bakelite nahi hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Bakelite = phenol-formaldehyde se bana thermosetting plastic, jo ek baar dhalne ke baad dobara pighalta nahi; bijli ke saamaanon mein istemal hota hai.

qe: Which chemical is used to 'Preserve' milk samples for analytical laboratory testing?
qh: प्रयोगशाला परीक्षण के लिए दूध के नमूनों को संरक्षित करने हेतु किस रसायन का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Doodh ke nakli (analytical) pareekshan ke liye namune ko bachaye rakhne ke liye potassium dichromate (K2Cr2O7) daala jaata hai - ye ek prabal okseedak (oxidising) hai jo dooth mein jeevan (bacteria) ko badhne nahi deta, isliye namuna kuchh samay tak kharab nahi hota aur usmein milk fat, SNF aadi ki jaanch theek se ho jaati hai. Namak ya cheeni se ye kaam theek se nahi hota aur formaldehyde (formalin) ka istemal shaareerik namuno (tissue) ke liye hota hai - doodh ke rasayanik pareekshan mein potassium dichromate hi standard preservative maana jaata hai. Exam point: doodh ke namune ke liye preservative = potassium dichromate (K2Cr2O7); formaldehyde jeev-vigyaan ke tissue sample ke liye istemal hota hai.

qe: The 'Refractive Index' and brilliance of optical glass is increased by adding which metal oxide?
qh: ऑप्टिकल कांच का अपवर्तनांक और चमक बढ़ाने के लिए उसमें किस धातु का ऑक्साइड मिलाया जाता है?
e: Optical glass (jaise flint glass) mein sisa oksaid (lead oxide) milane se us padarth ka apvartan-ank (refractive index) aur bikhraav (dispersion) badh jaata hai, isliye lens-patli (prism) aur ainak ke lens patle par zyada chamakdar aur saaf chhavi dete hain - yahi karan hai ki mehngi camera lens aur durbin mein lead wala kaanch istemal hota hai. Aluminium, iron ya sodium oxide se aise gun nahi milte (ye kaanch ko halka, rang-dar ya sasta banate hain) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Lekin sisa hone ke karan aise kaanch ko khane-peedhne ke bartan ke liye upyukt nahi maana jaata. Exam point: optical glass ke apvartan-ank aur chamak badhane ke liye lead (sisa) oksaid milaya jaata hai; isliye flint glass mein lead hota hai.

qe: Which 'Natural Dye' is extracted from the plant *Indigofera tinctoria*?
qh: पौधे *Indigofera tinctoria* से कौन सा प्रसिद्ध प्राकृतिक रंजक प्राप्त होता है?
e: Indigo (neel) rang Indigofera tinctoria paudhe ki pattiyon se nikaala jaata hai - iske patton mein indican naam ka padaarth hota hai jise paani mein bhigo kar kinyavein (fermentation) se todkar neela rang tayaar kiya jaata hai; isi rang se jeens (denim) kapde range jaate hain. Henna (mehndi), saffron (kesar) aur haldi anya prakrutik rang hain jo alag paudhon se milte hain, isliye ye vikalp galat hain. Aaj bahut bhaag mein indigo sanshleshit (synthetic) roop mein bhi banaya jaata hai, par uska mool paudh yahi hai. Exam point: Indigofera tinctoria se indigo (neel) dye milta hai; iska istemal jeens-rangeen (denim dyeing) mein hota hai.

qe: What is Indian 'Waterproof' drafting ink made of?
qh: वाटरप्रूफ ड्राफ्टिंग स्याही (Indian Ink) मुख्य रूप से किससे बनती है?
o: Carbon Black and Shellac in Alkali
e: Bharat ka jal-rodhak (waterproof) drafting ink (Indian ink) carbon black (kaalaa) aur shellac (lac) ko kshar (alkali) mein gholekar banaya jaata hai - shellac ise kapde/kaagaz par chipkaye rakhta hai aur paani se bachaata hai, aur carbon black gehra kaala rang deta hai. Alcohol, pencil lead ya cheeni-paani se aisi sthir siyahi nahi banti (ye bhaap ban jaati hai ya mit jaati hai) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi siyahi ka istemal nakshon (maps) aur imaarati chaaron (drawings) mein hota hai jahan paani lagne par bhi chhapna nahi chahiye. Exam point: Indian (waterproof) ink = carbon black + shellac, kshar (alkali) mein ghula; shellac paani se bachaata hai aur carbon black ka rang deta hai.

qe: Which gas is filled in traditional 'Incandescent' light bulbs to prevent tungsten evaporation?
qh: पारंपरिक बिजली के बल्बों में टंगस्टन फिलामेंट के वाष्पीकरण को रोकने के लिए कौन सी गैस भरी जाती है?
e: Purane bulb (incandescent lamp) mein argon aur nitrogen ka mishran bhara jaata hai - ye nishkriya (inert) gases hain jo filament ke tungsten ki bhaap (evaporation) ko rok dete hain aur bulb ke kaanch par jamne se bachaate hain, jisse bulb lamba chalta hai. Hydrogen aur oxygen garm filament ke saath kriya kar sakte hain (oxygen to jal bhi sakta hai), aur chlorine bhi kriya karta hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: LED-CFL aaj incandescent bulb ki jagah le rahe hain kyunki wo kam bijli khaate hain. Exam point: incandescent bulb mein argon-nitrogen ka mishran bhara jaata hai (inert gas), jo tungsten filament ki bhaap rokta hai; oxygen-hydrogen kriya karte hain isliye nahi.

qe: What is 'Teflon' (PTFE) chemically?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से 'टेफ्लॉन' (PTFE) क्या है?
e: Teflon ka rasayanik naam PTFE (polytetrafluoroethylene) hai - ye ek fluorocarbon polymer hai jismein carbon ki chain par fluorine atom jude hote hain; C-F bandh bahut mazboot hone ke karan ye rasarahit (chemically inert), jal-rodhak aur kam gharsh (low friction) hota hai, isliye non-stick tawa, gasket aur bhautik chaplon ke bachav-lep mein istemal hota hai. Carbohydrate, polyester ya polyamide se ye bilkul alag hai kyunki usmein fluorine nahi hota aur wo paani/garmi se prabhavit hote hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Teflon = PTFE, fluorocarbon polymer (C-F bandh wala), non-stick, rasarahit aur gharshan-rodhak lep ke liye istemal hota hai.

qe: Which chemical is commercially used for 'Artificial fruit ripening' by releasing acetylene?
qh: कच्चे फलों को पकाने के लिए किस रसायन का उपयोग किया जाता है जो नमी से एसिटिलीन छोड़ता है?
e: Calcium carbide (CaC2) par nami lagne se acetylene gas banti hai, aur kayi vyapari isi gas ka istemal fake 'pakaa' (ripening) ke liye karte hain - calcium carbide ko paani mein daal kar gas banai jaati hai aur kachche phalon ke saath rakh diya jaata hai. Lekin dhyan rakhein ki asli pakaa ke liye paudhon ka prakritik hormone ethylene gas hota hai, jo surakshit hai; calcium carbide gas aarseen (arsenic) aur phosphorus jaisi ashudhiyan bhi de sakti hai isliye khane-yogya nahi maana jaata aur khadi-suraksha niyamon mein iska istemal mana hai - isliye baaki vikalp galat hain. Exam point: artificial pakaa ke liye natak mein calcium carbide (acetylene gas) istemal hota hai par ye hanikarak hai; asli surakshit tareeka ethylene gas ka istemal hai (khadi-suraksha niyam).

qe: What is 'Fullerene' (C60) commonly called due to its dome-like structure?
qh: कार्बन के C60 अपरूप को उसकी संरचना के कारण आमतौर पर क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Fullerene C60 ko uske gol-gumbad jaise dhanche ke karan Buckminsterfullerene ya 'Buckyball' kaha jaata hai - ye 60 carbon atomon se bana football (pentagon-hexagon jaali) jaisa molecule hai, jise 1985 mein Kroto, Smalley aur Curl ne khoja (Nobel 1996). Coke, diamond aur graphite carbon ke anya roop (allotropes) hain, jinmein carbon ke atom alag tarah se jude hote hain (diamond mein tetrahidral, graphite mein patli paratein, coke mein amorf) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: C60 fullerene = Buckminsterfullerene / Buckyball, football-jaisa carbon molecule; duniya ke teen khaas carbon-roop diamond, graphite aur fullerene hain (1985, Nobel).

qe: Which substance is used as a volatile 'Propellant' in aerosol deodorant sprays?
qh: एरोसोल स्प्रे और डियोड्रेंट में तरल को बाहर निकालने के लिए किस 'प्रणोदक' (Propellant) का उपयोग होता है?
o: Liquefied Petroleum gases like Butane or Propane
e: Aerosol deodorant aur spray can mein 'propellant' ke roop mein butane-propane jaise draveekrut (liquefied) petroleum gases milaaye jaate hain - ye can ke bhitar dabav paida karte hain aur nariki (nozzle) kholne par padarth ko barik boondon (fine droplets) mein bahar fenk dete hain. Alcohol, paani ya tel ke saath aisa turant fenkne wala gun nahi hota (paani aur tel bhaari hote hain aur unse chhitke nahi bante) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Purane spray mein CFC ka istemal hota tha jo ozon ko nuksan pahunchata tha, isliye ab parlagon (hydrocarbon) propellants istemal hote hain. Exam point: aerosol spray ka propellant = LPG jaisi butane-propane gases; ye dabav bana kar padarth ko barik boondon mein bahar chhodti hain (CFC ki jagah ab hydrocarbon).

qe: What is 'Varnish' chemically?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से 'वार्निश' (Varnish) क्या है?
o: Solution of natural or synthetic resin in drying oil or volatile solvent
e: Varnish ek paardarshi (transparent) lep hai jise prakrutik ya sanshleshit resin ko sukhne wale tel (drying oil) ya vaashpsheel (volatile) solvent mein gholekar banaya jaata hai - ye lakdi ki satah par jam jaata hai aur ek chamak-dar, bachav wali parat deta hai, par ismein rangne ke liye pigment nahi daala jaata. Paint mein pigment (rang) hota hai, wax alag padarth hai aur 'liquid plastic' koi rasayanik shabd nahi - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi liye varnish se lakdi ka asli rang aur dhaancha dikhta rehta hai jabki paint usse dhak deta hai. Exam point: varnish = resin ka sukhne wale tel ya volatile solvent mein ghulaimaan (bina pigment), jo lakdi par paardarshi, chamakdar aur bachav wali parat banata hai.

qe: Which membrane separation process is industrial standard for the desalination of seawater?
qh: समुद्री जल को मीठा (पीने योग्य) बनाने के लिए किस झिल्ली पृथक्करण प्रक्रिया का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Samudri paani se namak hataane (desalination) ke liye audyogik star par reverse osmosis (RO) sabse aam vidhi hai - ismein paani ko adhik daab (high pressure) se aisi jhilli (membrane) se guzara jaata hai jo namak ke ionon ko rok deti hai aur keval paani ke kan nikal jaate hain. Alum, sedimentation aur chlorine paani se mail/jeevan hatane ke liye hote hain, namak (dissolved salt) hatane ke liye nahi - Ye vikalp galat hain. RO ke alava distillation aur multi-stage flash bhi istemal hote hain, par aaj ghar-gar aur shehron mein RO plants sabse aam hain kyunki ye kam urja khaate hain. Exam point: samudri paani se namak hataane (desalination) ke liye sabse aam vidhi = Reverse Osmosis (RO); ismein dabav se paani membrane se guzarta hai aur namak ke ion ruk jaate hain.

qe: What was 'Celluloid', the pioneer commercial plastic invented in 1870?
qh: 1870 में विकसित पहला व्यावसायिक प्लास्टिक 'सेलुलॉइड' किनका मिश्रण था?
e: Celluloid duniya ka pehla vyaavsayik (commercial) plastic tha, jise 1870 mein John Wesley Hyatt ne cellulose nitrate (nitrocellulose) ko camphor ke saath ghol kar banaya - camphor ise lachila (plasticised) banata hai, isliye ye film, gudde, shirt ke collar aur purane photo film mein istemal hua. Ye prakrutik fiber, dhatu-mishran ya petroleum wax nahi hai, kyunki iska aadhar celulose aur camphor hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Celluloid jald aag pakadne wala tha, isliye baad mein iski jagah surakshit plastics ne li. Exam point: celluloid (1870, Hyatt) = nitrocellulose + camphor (plasticiser); duniya ka pehla commercial plastic, photo film aur collars mein istemal hua.

qe: Which chemical is the opaque white base in paper correction fluids (white-out)?
qh: कागज़ पर स्याही छिपाने वाले करेक्शन फ्लूइड (व्हाइट-आउट) में मुख्य सफेद रंगद्रव्य क्या होता है?
o: Titanium Dioxide ($TiO_2$) in a fast-drying solvent
e: Correction fluid (white-out) mein titanium dioxide (TiO2) daala jaata hai, jo bahut safed aur dhakne wala (opaque) pigment hai, aur uske saath ek jaldi sukhne wala solvent hota hai (jaise methylcyclohexane) taaki kaagaz par patli safed parat turant jam jaaye. Oxalic acid, acetone, paani se aisi dhakne wali safed parat nahi banti - oxalic acid kis kaam ka, acetone solvent hai par safed rang nahi deta, aur paani der se sukhata hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi karan white-out ko likhe hue akshar par lagane se wo chhip jaate hain aur upar dobara likha ja sakta hai. Exam point: correction fluid ka safed aadhaar = titanium dioxide (TiO2), jaldi sukhne wale solvent ke saath; TiO2 ki uttm dhakne ki (opacity) aur safedi iska karan hai.

qe: What is the primary industrial function of 'Zeolite' (Permutit)?
qh: उद्योगों में 'जिओलाइट' (परम्यूटिट) का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
o: Softening permanent hardness of water via ion exchange
e: Zeolite (permutit) ka mukhya audyogik kaam paani ki sthaayi (permanent) sakhtai hataana hai - iske sodium ion paani ke calcium aur magnesium ionon se ion-vinimay (ion exchange) karte hain, jisse paani se sakhtai (hardness ke liye zimmedar Ca/Mg) nikal jaati hai aur paani narm ho jaata hai. Khaas baat yahi hai ki ye sthaayi (permanent) sakhtai par bhi kaam karta hai (jise ubaalne se nahi hataaya ja sakta), jabki ubaalne ki vidhi keval sirf kshnik sakhtai hatati hai. Kagaz, sona-shodhan ya khad banane mein zeolite ka istemal alag alag roopon mein hota hai par uska mukhya audyogik kaam paani narm karna hi hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: zeolite (permutit) = permanent hardness hataane wala ion-exchange padarth; iske Na+ paani ke Ca2+/Mg2+ se badal jaate hain (isliye sthaayi sakhtai bhi hat jaati hai).

qe: Which chemical salt is known in photography as 'Hypo'?
qh: फोटोग्राफी में 'हाइपो' के नाम से किस रासायनिक लवण को जाना जाता है?
e: Photography mein 'hypo' naam se mashhoor lavan sodium thiosulfate pentahydrate (Na2S2O3.5H2O) hai - film par bache hue apekshit (unreacted) silver halide ko ghula kar hatane ke liye isi ka istemal hota hai, isliye ise 'fixer' bhi kehte hain. Sodium carbonate washing soda hai, sodium chloride saadharan namak aur sodium hydroxide caustic soda - inka koi sambandh photography ke fixer se nahi hai, Ye vikalp galat hain. Yaad rakhein: developer (hydroquinone) ne chhavi bana di thi; ab fixer us parat ko sthir karta hai. Exam point: photography ka 'hypo' (fixer) = sodium thiosulfate pentahydrate (Na2S2O3.5H2O); ye bache hue silver halide ko ghula kar chhavi (image) ko sthir karta hai.

qe: What distinguishes 'Enamel' paint from ordinary water-based paints?
qh: 'इनेमल' पेंट साधारण पानी वाले पेंट से किस प्रकार भिन्न है?
o: Oil-resin base drying to a hard, glossy, and weather-resistant surface
e: Enamel paint ek tel-resin (oil-resin) aadhaar wala lep hai jo hawa mein sukh kar kathor, chamak-dar aur mausam-rodhak (weather-resistant) parat banata hai - isi karan ye bahar (iron gate, lakdi ka saamaan) aur ghar ke bahari hisson ke liye upyukt hai. Saadharan paani wale paint (distemper) se aisi kathor parat nahi banti, 'liquid clay' ya whitewash chalk se bhi mausam-rodhak chamak nahi milti - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi tarah enamel paint lakdi ki nami rokta hai aur uski chamak der tak rehti hai. Exam point: enamel paint = oil-resin base wala sukhne wala lep, jo kathor, chamakdar aur mausam-rodhak parat banata hai; distemper/whitewash paani-aadharit halke lep hain.

qe: Which gases are recycled and reacted in the 'Solvay Process' to synthesize Sodium Carbonate?
qh: सोडियम कार्बोनेट बनाने की 'सोल्वे प्रक्रिया' में किन गैसों का चक्रण होता है?
e: Solvay prakriya mein carbon dioxide (CO2) aur ammonia (NH3) ko namak ke gaadhe ghulaimaan (brine) mein bharke punah-chakra (recycle) kiya jaata hai - ammonia paani mein ghul kar kshariya madhyam banata hai, CO2 se carbonate banta hai aur sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3) jamta hai, jise garam karke sodium carbonate (Na2CO3) banaya jaata hai; ammonia aur CO2 dobara istemal ke liye wapas le liye jaate hain. Hydrogen-chlorine (HCl ka jod), sulfur dioxide ya oxygen-nitrogen is prakriya ke mukhya ghatak nahi hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Yahi vidhi aaj bhi soda ash (washing soda base) ke bade paimane par utpadan ka aadhaar hai. Exam point: Solvay prakriya mein CO2 aur NH3 punah-chakra (recycle) hote hain; isse NaHCO3 aur aage sodium carbonate (soda ash) banta hai.

qe: What is the single cyclic monomer used to manufacture 'Nylon 6'?
qh: 'नायलॉन 6' का निर्माण किस एकल चक्रीय एकलक से किया जाता है?
e: Nylon 6 keval ek cyclic monomer 'caprolactam' ke khulne (ring opening) aur polimerikaran se banta hai - isliye ise '6' kaha jaata hai kyunki uski ikai (unit) mein 6 carbon hote hain. Vinyl chloride PVC banata hai, styrene polystyrene, aur ethene polythene - isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Nylon 6,6 (hexamethylenediamine aur adipic acid se) se alag hone ke liye yaad rakhein: Nylon 6 mein ek hi monomer hota hai, jabki Nylon 6,6 mein do monomer bhent (condensation) karte hain. Exam point: Nylon 6 = keval caprolactam (cyclic monomer, ring opening polymerisation) se; Nylon 6,6 do monomer (adipic acid + hexamethylenediamine) se banta hai.

qe: Which strong oxidizing gas is used to kill bacteria and disinfect treated wastewater without leaving chemical trihalomethanes?
qh: अपशिष्ट जल उपचार में बिना कोई जहरीला अवशेष छोड़े जीवाणुओं को मारने के लिए किस गैस का उपयोग होता है?
e: Ozone (O3) ek prabal okseedak gas hai jo paani mein jeevan (bacteria, virus) ko maar deta hai, par ye kriya ke baad khud oxygen (O2) mein badal jaata hai - isliye isse saaf kiya gaya paani chlorine jaisa trihalomethane jaisa koi rasayanik awshesh (byproduct) nahi chhodta aur swaad-gandh bhi nahi badalta. Methane, carbon monoxide aur hydrogen aise jeevan-nashak (disinfectant) nahi hain, Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi karan aajkal ozone se paani ki safai (ozonation) ko chlorine se behtar aur surakshit maana jaata hai. Exam point: paani ke jeevan-nashan (disinfection) ke liye bina trihalomethane chhodne wala gas = ozone (O3), jo kriya ke baad O2 ban jaata hai; chlorine trihalomethane bana sakta hai.

qe: Which transparent polymer is used for manufacturing optical discs (CDs/DVDs) and bullet-resistant glass?
qh: ऑप्टिकल डिस्क (CD/DVD) और बुलेटप्रूफ ग्लास बनाने के लिए किस मजबूत पारदर्शी बहुलक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: CD, DVD jaise optical discs aur bullet-resistant (goli-rodhak) kaanch mein polycarbonate (Lexan) naam ka paardarshi (transparent) polymer istemal hota hai kyunki ye bahut mazboot, jhatka-rook (impact-resistant) aur paardarshi hota hai - isi karan ise 'unbreakable glass' bhi kehte hain. Polyester, PVC aur polyethylene se itni mazbooti aur paardarshita saath mein nahi milti (PVC dhundhla-lekin-jhatka kamzor, PE dhundhla aur naram) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi tarah helmet ke face-shield, goggles aur luggage mein bhi polycarbonate istemal hota hai. Exam point: optical discs (CD/DVD) aur bullet-resistant glass ke liye paardarshi, jhatka-rook polymer = polycarbonate (Lexan).

qe: Which chemical is artificially dispersed in clouds during 'Cloud Seeding' to trigger rainfall?
qh: 'कृत्रिम वर्षा' (क्लाउड सीडिंग) कराने के लिए बादलों पर किस रसायन का छिड़काव किया जाता है?
e: Cloud seeding (baadal bijai) mein silver iodide (AgI) ke bahut barik kanon ko hawai jahaaz se baadal mein pheinla kar barish karwai jaati hai - AgI ka crystal dhancha barf (ice) ke dhanche se bahut milta hai, isliye baadal ki nami usi ke around jam kar barf ke chhote kan banati hai jo bhaari hokar barish ke roop mein girte hain. Silver nitrate, potassium permanganate ya copper sulfate is khaas kaam ke liye standard nahi hain (in ka crystal dhancha barf se nahi milta) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Barish karaane ke liye kuchh jagah namak (salt) ka churn bhi istemal hota hai, par AgI sabse aam hai. Exam point: cloud seeding ke liye chhida jaane wala padarth = silver iodide (AgI), jiska crystal dhancha barf jaisa hone se nami jam kar barish deti hai.

qe: What is 'White Vitriol' chemically?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से 'सफेद थोथा' (White Vitriol) क्या है?
e: 'White Vitriol' ka rasayanik naam zinc sulfate heptahydrate hai, jiska formula ZnSO4.7H2O hai - ismein saat paani ke angushth hote hain aur ye safed crystal banata hai; iska istemal zinc dhatu nikalne, kapde ke rang mein pakad (mordant) aur dhatu-lep mein hota hai. FeSO4.7H2O green vitriol (Hara Kasis) hai, MgSO4.7H2O Epsom salt, aur CuSO4.5H2O blue vitriol (Neela Thotha) - isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Vitriol naam ke lavan unke rang se pehchaane jaate hain: safed (zinc), hara (iron), neela (copper). Exam point: white vitriol = zinc sulfate heptahydrate (ZnSO4.7H2O); green vitriol FeSO4.7H2O aur blue vitriol CuSO4.5H2O hai.

qe: Which class of chemical additives is blended into polyurethane foam in car seats and furniture to retard flame spread?
qh: फर्नीचर के फोम में आग को तेजी से फैलने से रोकने के लिए कौन से 'फ्लेम रिटार्डेंट' रसायन मिलाए जाते हैं?
e: Polyurethane foam ko aag pakadne se rokne ke liye usme brominated ya organophosphate agni-rodhak (flame retardants) milaye jaate hain - ye bahan ko garam hone par aise padarth chhodte hain jo jalne ki kriya ko dheema kar dete hain; isliye car seat, sofa aur gaddon ke foam mein inka istemal hota hai. Alcohol, methane ya gasoline khud jwala-sheel (flammable) hote hain aur aag badhaate hain, rok nahi sakte - isliye wo vikalp bilkul galat hain. Yaad rakhein: agni-rodhak aag ko poori tarah 'rok' nahi karte, wo badhne ki gati ko dheema karke bachav ka samay badha dete hain. Exam point: polyurethane foam mein agni-failav rokne ke liye brominated / organophosphate flame retardants milaye jaate hain; alcohol-methane-gasoline khud jalne wale padarth hain.

qe: What is traditional 'Distemper' paint formulated with?
qh: पारंपरिक 'डिस्टेंपर' पेंट मुख्य रूप से किससे तैयार किया जाता है?
o: Chalk powder (whiting), water, and animal glue / casein binder
e: Distemper ek paani-aadharit (water-based) sasta lep hai jo chuna churn (whiting) ko paani aur jaanvaron ke glue ya casein binder ke saath milaakar banaya jaata hai - ise deewaron ki andaruni safedi aur halke rang ke liye istemal karte hain (jaise purane ghar deewaron par whitewash/distemper). Dhatui paint, oil paint aur shudh varnish alag-shreshi lep hain jinmein tel ya resin ka aadhaar hota hai aur wo bahari kaam ke liye hote hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Distemper chuna hone ke karan sasta hai par paani lagne par mit jaata hai, isliye bahari deewaron ke liye ye theek nahi. Exam point: distemper = chuna churn (whiting) + paani + animal glue/casein binder; andaruni deewaron ka sasta paani-aadharit lep hai.

qe: What metallic film is deposited on flat glass sheets to produce modern household mirrors?
qh: आधुनिक घरेलू दर्पणों के पीछे परावर्तक सतह बनाने के लिए किस धातु की पतली परत चढ़ाई जाती है?
e: Aajkal ke gharailu darpan (mirror) kaanch ki chadar par silver ya aluminium ki patli parat jamkar (vapour deposition) banaye jaate hain, jiske upar taamba (copper) aur paint ki raksha-parat chadhai jaati hai - silver ki parat roshni ka sabse achha paravartan karti hai. Zinc, mercury ya lead ke filmon se aisa saaf-bimba nahi milta (pehle mercury-tin wala 'tinning' tareeka tha, jo seh-suraksha ke liye chhod diya gaya hai), Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi karan mirror ke peeche ki parat ko nami se bachaana zaroori hai. Exam point: aadhunik darpan = kaanch par silver ya aluminium ki parat (vapour deposition) + copper aur paint ka bachav; pehle istemal hone wali mercury-tin vidhi seh-suraksha karan chhod di gayi.

qe: What is 'Biodiesel' chemically produced from vegetable oils?
qh: वनस्पति तेलों से बनने वाला 'बायोडीजल' रासायनिक रूप से क्या होता है?
e: Biodiesel vegetable tel (jaise soybean, palash, khoya tel) se banne wala eendhan hai jiska rasayanik naam fatty acid methyl esters (FAME) hai - ismein tel ke triglycerides ko methanol ke saath trans-esterification kriya se badla jaata hai, jisse glycerol alag ho jaata hai aur methyl ester (biodiesel) banta hai. Shudh ethanol, petroleum ether ya seedhe alkane nahi nikalte, kyunki is kriya mein ester group banta hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi karan biodiesel diesel engine mein lagbhag wahi tarah jalta hai, par thodi kam urja deta hai aur sulfar bahut kam hota hai. Exam point: biodiesel = fatty acid methyl esters (FAME), jo tel ke trans-esterification (methanol ke saath) se bante hain; glycerol is kriya ka sahasutpad (byproduct) hai.

qe: Which chemical salt softens hard water by precipitating calcium as insoluble calcium carbonate?
qh: कौन सा लवण कठोर जल के कैल्शियम को अघुलनशील कार्बोनेट के रूप में अवक्षेपित करके जल को मृदु बनाता है?
e: Sakht (hard) paani ki sthaayi sakhtai hataane ya kam karne ke liye sodium carbonate (washing soda) istemal hota hai - ye paani ke calcium ionon ke saath kriya karke calcium carbonate banata hai jo paani mein nahi ghalta (avkShepya) aur neeche baith jaata hai, isliye paani se calcium nikal jaata hai. Sirka (acid) saamaanya saafai ke liye, namak aur bleaching powder jeevan-nashan/dhulai ke liye hain par ve calcium ko is tarah awkshepit (precipitate) nahi karte - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi siddhant se soda ash (Na2CO3) kapde dhone aur bhatti (boiler) ke paani ke upchar mein istemal hota hai. Exam point: sakht paani ke calcium ko calcium carbonate ke roop mein awkshepit (precipitate) karne ke liye sodium carbonate (washing soda) istemal hota hai; yahi sthaayi sakhtai ghatata hai.

qe: Which chemical is the primary acid component of 'Baking Powder' that reacts with baking soda to release $CO_2$?
qh: बेकिंग पाउडर में बेकिंग सोडा के साथ मिलाने वाला मुख्य खाद्य अम्ल कौन सा होता है?
o: Potassium Hydrogen Tartrate (Cream of Tartar) or Tartaric Acid
e: Baking powder mein khameer (fermentation) karne wala tezaab ke roop mein potassium hydrogen tartrate (cream of tartar) ya tartaric acid hota hai, jo baking soda (NaHCO3) ke saath paani mein milte hi kriya karke carbon dioxide gas chhodta hai - yahi gas cake ko fulata (phulaati) hai. Hydrochloric, nitric aur sulfuric acid prabal khaniz tezaab hain aur khane ke liye bilkul anupukt hain (ye hanikarak hain), Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein ki acid aur base ka sahi santulan hi baking powder ka raaz hai; zyada acid se cake khatta aur zyada base se kadwa ho sakta hai. Exam point: baking powder ke acid ghatak = cream of tartar (potassium hydrogen tartrate) ya tartaric acid; ye baking soda se kriya karke CO2 gas dete hain jisse aata fulata hai.

qe: What is the primary chlorinated organic solvent used in modern commercial 'Dry Cleaning'?
qh: आधुनिक 'ड्राई क्लीनिंग' में उपयोग किया जाने वाला मुख्य अजलीय विलायक कौन सा है?
e: Aajkal vyaavsayik dry cleaning mein mukhya chlorinated solvent tetrachloroethylene (perchloroethylene, 'perc') istemal hota hai - ye tel-chiknaai (grease) aur daagon ko aasaani se ghula leta hai, jaldi vashpit (volatile) hota hai aur kapde ko kharab nahi karta, isliye wool-silk jaise kapde bina paani ke saaf ho jaate hain. Methanol, sirka (vinegar) ya paani dry cleaning ke liye upyukt nahi (paani se kapde sikudte/kharab hote hain, sirka kamzor hai) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Perc ki bhaap seh-hatya ke liye hanikarak hoti hai, isliye aajkal 'green dry cleaning' mein liquid CO2 jaisa vikalp bhi istemal ho raha hai. Exam point: dry cleaning ka mukhya solvent = tetrachloroethylene (perchloroethylene/Perc); ye daag aur tel gholta hai, isliye paani ke bina kapde saaf hote hain.

qe: What is 'Flint Glass' characterized by?
qh: 'फ्लिंट ग्लास' (Flint Glass) की मुख्य विशेषता क्या है?
o: High refractive index and high optical dispersion (contains lead)
e: Flint glass ki khaas pehchaan yahi hai ki usmein sisa oksaid (lead oxide) hota hai, jisse uska apvartan-ank (refractive index) aur bikhraav (dispersion) bahut badh jaata hai - isliye ye prisms, optical lens aur chamakdar glassware mein istemal hota hai. Prabal rasarahit-pan borosilicate (Pyrex) ka gun hai, kam galaank wala kaanch soda glass hota hai, aur hara rang iron ki ashudhi se aata hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: sisa ki maatra se hi 'crystal' kaanch ki chamak aur ring (aawaz) badhti hai. Exam point: flint glass = sisa (lead) wala kaanch, uchch apvartan-ank aur bikhraav; optical lens aur prisms mein istemal hota hai.

qe: What is the aqueous pH nature of pure 'Washing Soda' ($Na_2CO_3$) in water?
qh: जल में 'धावन सोडा' ($Na_2CO_3$) के विलयन की प्रकृति कैसी होती है?
e: Shudh washing soda (Na2CO3) paani mein gholne par kshariya (alkaline) hota hai, kyunki ye prabal kshaar (NaOH) aur kamzor tezaab (carbonic acid) ka lavan hai - iska carbonate ion paani se kriya karke OH- ion paida karta hai (jaleeya apghatan), jisse pH 7 se zyada ho jaata hai. Udasin, acidik ya dhruv-baahud (amphoteric) wale vikalp galat hain kyunki prabal base ke asar ke karan ghulaimaan saaf taur par kshariya hota hai. Isi kshariyat ke karan washing soda kapde ki chiknaai todta hai aur sakht paani ke calcium ko awkshepit karke safai badhata hai. Exam point: washing soda (Na2CO3) ka ghulaimaan kshariya (alkaline, pH 7 se zyada) hota hai kyunki ye prabal base aur kamzor acid ka lavan hai (jaleeya apghatan se OH- banta hai).

qe: What is the commercial preservation solution 'Formalin'?
qh: जीवविज्ञान प्रयोगशालाओं में नमूनों को संरक्षित करने वाला 'फॉर्मेलिन' क्या है?
o: 37-40% aqueous solution of Formaldehyde (with methanol stabilizer)
e: 'Formalin' formaldehyde gas ka 37-40% jaleeya (aqueous) ghulaimaan hota hai, jismein thoda methanol sthirta (stabiliser) ke liye milaya jaata hai - ye jeev-vigyaan ki pradarshika (specimen) aur tissue ko sadne se bachaata hai (fixation) kyunki ye protein ko jamaa deta hai. Shudh formaldehyde gas ke roop mein istemal nahi hota (wo gas hai, ghulaimaan roop mein hi kaam aata hai), aur benzene-acetone ya pure solvents iska roop nahi hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: formalin seh-hatya ke liye hanikarak hota hai, isliye laboratory mein ise savdhani se istemal karte hain. Exam point: formalin = 37-40% formaldehyde ka jaleeya ghulaimaan (methanol stabiliser ke saath); tissue aur specimen ko preserve (fix) karne ke liye istemal hota hai.

qe: Why are complexing phosphate 'Builders' like Sodium Tripolyphosphate (STPP) added to synthetic laundry detergents?
qh: लॉन्ड्री डिटर्जेंट में सोडियम ट्राइपोलीफॉस्फेट (STPP) जैसे 'बिल्डर्स' क्यों मिलाए जाते हैं?
o: To chelate hard water $Ca^{2+}$ and $Mg^{2+}$ ions and prevent surfactant inactivation
e: Synthetic dhulai ke powder mein sodium tripolyphosphate (STPP) jaisi 'builder' cheezein isliye milai jaati hain ki ye sakht paani ke calcium (Ca2+) aur magnesium (Mg2+) ionon ko apne saath jamaa (chelate) kar leti hain - warna ye ion detergent ke surfactant ke saath mil kar avkShepya (scum) banate hain aur surfactant ki safai-prabhavta khatm ho jaati hai. Kapde ko safed karne, ghanatv badhane ya khushbu dene ke liye alag ghatak hote hain (whitener, filler, fragrance) - isliye wo vikalp is khaas kaam ke nahi hain. Lekin phosphate lake/water pollution badhata hai, isliye kai deshon mein ise seemit kiya gaya hai. Exam point: STPP jaisi builders = sakht paani ke Ca2+/Mg2+ ko chelate karke surfactant ko sakriya (active) rakhna; isse detergent sakht paani mein bhi safai deta hai.

qe: What is 'Glass' technically defined as in physical chemistry?
qh: भौतिक रसायन में 'कांच' को तकनीकी रूप से क्या माना जाता है?
e: Proaudyogik (technical) roop se kaanch ko 'atishit drav' (supercooled liquid / amorphic solid) kaha jaata hai - ismein silica ke molecule jamne par bhi nishchit crystal jaali nahi banti, balki ek avyaayav sthiti (disordered/amorphous state) mein hi jam jaate hain; isi karan kaanch paardarshi hota hai aur crystal ki tarah nishchit galaank nahi dikhata. Crystalline solid, aayaneet compound ya cross-linked polymer wale vikalp galat hain kyunki (a) crystal baithne par kaanch dhundhla ho jaata, (b) kaanch mein ion-covalent jaali hoti hai par wo ionic compound nahi, (c) polymer ki tarah lambi chain nahi hoti. Exam point: kaanch = atishit drav (amorphous solid), isliye paardarshi aur crystal jaise nishchit galaank bina hota hai; crystalline solid ke aks (X-ray) pattern kaanch mein nahi milte.

qe: Why is 'Gypsum' ($CaSO_4 \cdot 2H_2O$) ground into Portland cement clinker?
qh: पोर्टलैंड सीमेंट में 'जिप्सम' क्यों मिलाया जाता है?
o: To retard the initial flash setting time of Tricalcium Aluminate ($C_3A$)
e: Portland cement ke clinker mein jipsum (CaSO4.2H2O) isliye peesa jaata hai ki wo tricalcium aluminate (C3A) ki turant setting (flash set) ko dheema kar de - cement aur paani milkar tez kriya karta hai, jisse ghaula (paste) jaldi jama ho kar kaam kharab kar deta hai; gipsum us kriya ko dheema kar deta hai taaki cement par kaam karne ka poora samay mile. Raftaar badhane, safed rang dene ya kharche ghatane ke liye gipsum nahi daala jaata (safedi alag pigment se aati hai) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Yaad rakhein ki gipsum ki maatra 3-5% ke aas-paas rakhi jaati hai. Exam point: cement mein gipsum = setting dheemi karne ke liye (flash set rokne ke liye); ye tricalcium aluminate ki turant jamne wali kriya ko niyamit karta hai.

qe: What is the primary organic raw material consumed in the commercial 'Saponification' of soap?
qh: साबुन के औद्योगिक 'साबुनीकरण' में प्राथमिक कच्चा माल क्या होता है?
o: Triglycerides (Vegetable oils like palm/coconut or animal tallow)
e: Saabun banane (saponification) ki kriya mein mukhya kachcha maal triglycerides hote hain jo vegetable tel (jaise nariyal, palm) ya jaanvaron ki charbi (tallow) se milte hain - inhe kshar (NaOH) ke saath ubalne par triglyceride toot jaate hain aur saabun (fatty acid salt) tatha glycerol bante hain. Petroleum ka khaniz tel, polythene ya coal tar se saabun nahi banta (wo plastics aur rangon ke liye kachcha maal hain) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi liye saabun ke udyog ko tel-udyog se gehra sambandh hai, aur tel ki gangunakta (fatty acid chain) saabun ke foaming aur safai ke gun tay karti hai. Exam point: saponification mein mukhya organic kachcha maal = triglycerides (vegetable tel ya animal tallow); kshar se kriya kar inhe saabun aur glycerol mein badla jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Water Glass' chemically?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से 'वाटर ग्लास' (Water Glass) क्या है?
e: 'Water Glass' (jal-kach) ka rasayanik naam sodium silicate (Na2SiO3) hai - ye paani mein ghulne wala chamakdar padarth hai jiska istemal anda (egg) ke chhilke ko surakshit rakhne, fire-resisting lep, aur wood ko aag se bachane (fireproofing) mein hota hai. Iska naam 'water glass' isliye pada kyunki iska gaadha ghulaimaan sookh kar kaanch jaisi chamakdar parat bana deta hai. Magnesium silicate (talc), lead silicate (flint glass) aur calcium silicate (cement) alag padarth hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: water glass = sodium silicate (Na2SiO3); paani mein ghulta hai aur sookh kar kaanch jaisi bachav-parat banata hai (fireproofing, egg preservation).

qe: What specific dissolved salts cause 'Permanent Hardness' in municipal and ground water?
qh: जल में 'स्थायी कठोरता' किन विशिष्ट लवणों के घुले होने के कारण होती है?
o: Chlorides and Sulfates of Calcium and Magnesium ($CaCl_2, CaSO_4, MgCl_2, MgSO_4$)
e: Paani mein ghole hue calcium aur magnesium ke chlorides aur sulfates (jaise CaCl2, CaSO4, MgCl2, MgSO4) sthaayi sakhtai (permanent hardness) paida karte hain - inhe ubaalne (boiling) se nahi hataaya ja sakta, kyunki ye paani mein poore ghule rehte hain; inhe hataane ke liye sodium carbonate ya zeolite jaise rasayan/chalni ki zaroorat hoti hai. Sodium/potassium ke bicarbonates aur carbonates kshnik (temporary) sakhtai ke liye zimmedar hote hain jo ubaalne par hat jaati hai, aur iron ke nitrate aam sakhtai ke liye nahi jaane jaate - Ye vikalp galat hain. Yaad rakhne ka aasan tarika: chloride-sulfate = permanent, bicarbonate = temporary. Exam point: sthaayi sakhtai ke liye zimmedar = calcium aur magnesium ke chlorides aur sulfates (CaCl2, CaSO4, MgCl2, MgSO4); ye ubaalne se nahi hote, isliye 'permanent' kehlate hain.

qe: Which type of 'Glass' is standard for heat-resistant laboratory glassware and kitchen baking dishes?
qh: गर्मी सहन करने वाले प्रयोगशाला उपकरणों और बेकिंग बर्तनों के लिए किस कांच का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Garmi sahan karne wale laboratory ke kaach (glassware) aur oven-baking ke bartan ke liye borosilicate glass (jaise Pyrex) standard hai kyunki usmein silica ke saath boron oxide (B2O3) hota hai jo kaanch ka tharmal prasar gun (coefficient of expansion) bahut kam kar deta hai - isliye garam hone-par wo toot ya dirr nahi hota. Soda-lime glass saadharan kaanch hai (garam par toot sakta hai), lead crystal sajaavat ke liye hai, safety laminated glass goli-rodhak hota hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi karan Pyrex ko se-cone (bunsen) par garam karna, autoclave karna aur thanda-garam karna aasaani se kiya ja sakta hai. Exam point: garmi-sahak lab glassware aur baking dish = borosilicate glass (Pyrex), kyunki B2O3 milane se uski tharmal prasar-bindu (expansion) bahut kam hoti hai.

qe: What are the three principal oxide compounds constituting 'Portland Cement' clinker?
qh: 'पोर्टलैंड सीमेंट' के क्लिंकर में मुख्य रूप से कौन से तीन ऑक्साइड होते हैं?
e: Portland cement ke clinker ke teen mukhya oksaid hain chuna (lime, CaO), silica (SiO2) aur alumina (Al2O3) - inhe chune patthar (limestone) aur mitti (clay) ko 1400-1500 degree C par jala kar banaya jaata hai; inke saath thodi maatra mein iron oxide (Fe2O3) aur magnesia bhi hoti hai jo cement ke gun ko sudhaarti hai. Sisa-zinc-tin, iron-carbon-sulfur ya sodium-potash-magnesia cement ke mukhya teen oksaid nahi hain, Ye vikalp galat hain. Gaur karein: lime se cement ko bandhne ki shakti, silica se sthirta aur alumina se turant jamne (setting) ka gun milta hai. Exam point: cement clinker ke teen mukhya oxide = lime (CaO), silica (SiO2) aur alumina (Al2O3); inhi ke saath thoda iron oxide aur magnesia hota hai.

qe: What is 'Soft Soap' formulated with instead of Sodium Hydroxide?
qh: कठोर साबुन के स्थान पर 'मुलायम साबुन' (Soft Soap) बनाने में किसका उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: 'Soft soap' (narm saabun) ko sodium hydroxide (NaOH) ki jagah potassium hydroxide (KOH) se banaya jaata hai - sodium wala saabun kathor (hard) hota hai jo aam taur par batton mein milta hai, jabki potassium wala saabun narm, ghulne-wala aur pil-pil hota hai, isliye ise chikni malmal (liquid soap), shaving cream aur khaas keemiyai saabun ke liye istemal karte hain. Magnesium carbonate, calcium hydroxide ya ammonium hydroxide se yah khaas narm saabun nahi banta - Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: saabun ka narm ya kathor hona us me base ke dhaatu (Na ya K) par nirbhar karta hai. Exam point: soft soap = potassium hydroxide (KOH) se bana saabun (narm, pil-pil); hard soap sodium hydroxide (NaOH) se banta hai.

qe: What chemical compound is used as a dry powder in Type BC / ABC commercial fire extinguishers?
qh: सूखे रासायनिक अग्निशामक यंत्रों में पाउडर के रूप में किस रसायन का उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Sodium Bicarbonate / Potassium Bicarbonate (or Monoammonium Phosphate)
e: Type BC/ABC dry powder agni-shadak (fire extinguisher) mein sodium bicarbonate / potassium bicarbonate (BC ke liye) ya monoammonium phosphate (ABC ke liye) bhara hota hai - aag par padne ke karan ye powder garmi se toot kar carbon dioxide aur paani ki bhaap chhodta hai jo oxygen ko hata kar lau (flame) ko bujha deta hai. Copper sulfate, calcium chloride ya lead nitrate is kaam ke liye nahi istemal hote (ye rasayanik abhikarmak hain, aag bujhane wale powder nahi) - Ye vikalp galat hain. ABC wala powder teen tarah ki aag (solid, liquid aur bijli) par kaam karta hai, isliye wo zyada istemal hota hai. Exam point: dry powder fire extinguisher = sodium/potassium bicarbonate (BC) ya monoammonium phosphate (ABC); ye garmi se CO2 chhodkar aag bujhaate hain.

qe: What composite structure prevents automotive 'Safety Glass' (windshield) from shattering into sharp daggers upon impact?
qh: वाहनों के विंडशील्ड वाले 'सुरक्षा कांच' को टूटने पर बिखरने से बचाने के लिए क्या संरचना बनाई जाती है?
o: Two layers of annealed glass bonded with an intermediate Polyvinyl Butyral (PVB) plastic interlayer
e: Automotive safety glass (windshield) mein kaanch ki do paraton ke beech ek lachile (flexible) plastic - polyvinyl butyral (PVB) - ki patli parat chipkai jaati hai; takkar lagne par kaanch toot to jaata hai par uske tukde isi plastic par chipke rehte hain, isliye tez dhaar-daar tukde ud kar yatriyon ko nahi lagte. Lead sheet, tempered wire mesh ya boron coating se ye gun nahi milta (wire mesh wala purana bullet-proof type alag hai) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi liye aise kaanch ko 'laminated glass' bhi kehte hain aur us par 'AS1' jaisa nishaan bhi hota hai. Exam point: safety glass = do kaanch ki paratein + beech mein PVB plastic ki parat; tutne par tukde chipke rehte hain isliye chot nahi lagti.

qe: What thermal manufacturing process is termed the 'Annealing' of glass?
qh: कांच के निर्माण में 'एनीलिंग' (Annealing) की प्रक्रिया क्या है?
o: Controlled slow cooling inside a lehr oven to relieve internal structural stresses
e: Kaanch banane ke baad usmein andar ka tanaav (internal stress) bana reh jaata hai; ise hatane ke liye kaanch ko 'lehr' bhatti mein niyamit taur par dheere-dheere thanda kiya jaata hai - isi kriya ko annealing kehte hain. Achanak thanda karne par kaanch mein dirar (crack) aa jaati hai ya wo apne aap toot sakta hai, isliye dheema-samay wala thanda karna zaroori hai. Acid se etching, kinaron ki polishing ya ret ko pighlana alag prakriyaayein hain, annealing nahi - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi tarah dhaatu-udyog mein bhi annealing se dhaatu ke tanaav kam kiye jaate hain. Exam point: annealing = kaanch/dhaatu ko 'lehr' mein niyamit taur par dheere-thanda karna, jisse andar ka tanaav (stress) hat jaaye aur wo toote nahi.

qe: What is the industrial role of a 'Mordant' in traditional textile fabric dyeing?
qh: वस्त्र रंगाई में 'रंगबंधक' (Mordant) की औद्योगिक भूमिका क्या होती है?
o: A polyvalent metal ion complexing with both fiber and dye molecules to permanently fix the color
e: Kapde rangeen karne mein 'mordant' (rang pakadne wala padarth) bahu-sanyojak (polyvalent) dhaatu ion ka ghulaimaan hota hai - ye ion ek taraf rang ke molecule se aur doosri taraf kapde ke fiber se jud jaata hai, isliye rang dhulai aur roshni mein mit-ta nahi aur gehra tatha sthir ho jaata hai. Isi ke liye fitkari (alum) aur dhaatu ke lavan mordant ke roop mein istemal hote hain. Bleach karna, kapde ko kathor karna ya rang dhona alag kriyaayein hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Yaad rakhein: bina mordant wale rang (direct dyes) jaldi halke pad jaate hain, isliye gehre-sthir rang ke liye mordant zaroori hai. Exam point: mordant = rang aur fiber dono se judne wala bahu-sanyojak dhaatu ion, jo rang ko pakka aur gehra banata hai (jaise alum ka istemal).

qe: Which heavy mineral acid is designated the 'King of Chemicals' due to its ubiquitous role across global chemical industries?
qh: व्यापक औद्योगिक उपयोग के कारण किस खनिज अम्ल को 'रसायनों का राजा' कहा जाता है?
e: Sulfuric acid (H2SO4) ko 'King of Chemicals' kehte hain kyunki ye lagbhag har rasayanik udyog mein kisi na kisi roop mein istemal hota hai - khad (superphosphate, ammonium sulfate), rang-dye, dhatu-sanshodhan, battery, kapde ki safai aur petroleum-shodhan mein. Isi liye kisi desh ke audyogik vikas ka paimana uski sulfuric acid ki utpadan-matara (production) maani jaati hai. Nitric acid 'aqua fortis', hydrochloric acid 'muriatic acid' aur phosphoric acid khad ke liye jana jaata hai - 'King of Chemicals' ki upadhi sirf sulfuric acid ko mili hai, Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: King of Chemicals = sulfuric acid (H2SO4); iski utpadan-matara hi audyogik vikas ka paimana maani jaati hai.

qe: What historic explosive was invented by Alfred Nobel in 1867 by absorbing liquid nitroglycerin into an inert porous matrix?
qh: 1867 में अल्फ्रेड नोबेल ने तरल नाइट्रोग्लिसरीन को एक अक्रिय पदार्थ में सोखकर किस विस्फोटक का आविष्कार किया था?
o: Dynamite (Nitroglycerin absorbed into Kieselguhr diatomaceous earth)
e: Dynamite ka aavishkar 1867 mein Alfred Nobel ne kiya - unhone drav (liquid) nitroglycerin ko kieselguhr (diatomaceous earth) ki sukhi-churn (porous) chadar mein sakh kar istemal kiya, jisse nitroglycerin ki sanvedansheelta (sensitivity) kam ho gayi aur ushe surakshit taur par le jaana aur lagaana sambhav ho gaya. Isi khoj ne khade-khaano, suraang aur railway ke kaam ko bahut saral bana diya. Gunpowder bahut purana hai, gun cotton (nitrocellulose) alag padarth hai aur TNT baad ke samay ka dhamaaka hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Nobel ne isi daulat se Nobel puraskar shuru kiye. Exam point: dynamite (1867, Alfred Nobel) = nitroglycerin ko kieselguhr (diatomaceous earth) ki porous chadar mein sakh karke surakshit banaya gaya dhamaaka padarth.

qe: What is the chemical composition of commercial 'Bleaching Powder'?
qh: व्यावसायिक 'ब्लीचिंग पाउडर' का रासायनिक संघटन क्या है?
e: Bleaching powder ka rasayanik naam calcium oxychloride (CaOCl2) hai - ismein calcium hypochlorite ka mishran hota hai aur ye chune [Ca(OH)2] par chlorine gas ki kriya se banta hai. Ise paani ki safai, satah ki safai (disinfectant), kapde ki white washing aur safai-gharon (sanitation) mein istemal karte hain, kyunki paani mein gholne par ye chlorine chhodta hai jo jeevon ko naar deta hai. Potassium chlorate match banane mein, sodium chloride namak aur calcium carbonate chuna-patthar hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: bleaching powder mein 35-40% tak chlorine ki matara sammilit (available) hoti hai. Exam point: bleaching powder = calcium oxychloride/hypochlorite complex (CaOCl2), chune par chlorine ki kriya se bane; disinfection aur kapde ki safai mein istemal hota hai.

qe: Which chemical compound is the primary nitrogenous agricultural fertilizer synthesized by reacting ammonia with carbon dioxide?
qh: अमोनिया और कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड की अभिक्रिया द्वारा निर्मित प्रमुख नाइट्रोजन उर्वरक कौन सा है?
e: Urea [NH2CONH2] duniya ka sabse zyada utpadit nitrogen wala khad hai, jise ammonia (NH3) aur carbon dioxide (CO2) ki utkram (reverse) kriya se banaya jaata hai - dono gasen dabav aur taap ke aadheen mili kar urea aur paani banati hain. Ismein 46% nitrogen hota hai jo khadon mein sabse zyada hai, aur yahi karan hai ki urea sasta aur prabhavi nitrogen-khad hai. Ammonium sulfate, single superphosphate aur potassium nitrate anya khad hain jo alag kriyaon se bante hain (sulfate ka, phosphate ka aur potash ke saath mila hua) - isliye wo sahi nahi. Yaad rakhein: urea ko synthetic organic compound ke roop mein sabse pehle Wohler ne laboratory mein banaya tha. Exam point: ammonia aur CO2 ki kriya se banta mukhya nitrogen-khad = urea (NH2CONH2), jismein lagbhag 46% nitrogen hota hai.

qe: What is natural 'Talc' mineral pulverized into talcum powder chemically?
qh: टैल्कम पाउडर बनाने में प्रयुक्त प्राकृतिक 'टैल्क' (Talc) रासायनिक रूप से क्या है?
e: Talcum powder ka mukhya khaniz 'talc' hai jiska rasayanik naam hydrated magnesium silicate [Mg3Si4O10(OH)2] hai - ye ek bahut narm khaniz hai (mohs paimane par 1, sabse narm) isliye ushe pees kar barik churn banaya jaata hai. Talc barik churn ke roop mein khushbu ke saath mila kar twacha saaf rakhne aur pasina sokhne ke liye istemal hota hai; rang, kagaz aur ceramic udyog mein bhi iska istemal hai. Zinc stearate, aluminum oxide aur calcium carbonate alag padarth hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: talc ko barik churn ke roop mein kabhi shwas ke saath andar nahi jaane dena chahiye, kyunki ye phephdon ke liye hanikarak ho sakta hai. Exam point: talc = hydrated magnesium silicate [Mg3Si4O10(OH)2], mohs paimane ki sabse narm khaniz (1); talcum powder ka mukhya ghatak yahi hai.

qe: Which non-toxic white aerosol fog generation method is standardly used in theatrical stage productions?
qh: नाटकों और फिल्मों में कृत्रिम धुआँ (सफेद कोहरा) उत्पन्न करने के लिए किसका उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Solid Carbon Dioxide (Dry Ice) in warm water or atomized Glycol vapor
e: Stage par safed dhuaan (fog) banane ke liye shushk barf (dry ice, solid CO2) ko garam paani mein daala jaata hai ya glycol/vegetable oil ke barik kanon ko bhaap mein chhoda jaata hai - dry ice seedha gas ban jaati hai (sublimation) aur uske saath nami ki bhaap mil kar safed dhuaan dikhata hai; glycol wale fog mein propylene glycol ke kan hawai nami ke saath milkar bhaap banate hain. Sulfur jalane ya chlorine gas se dhuaan hanikarak hota hai aur lakdi ka buraada aag pakad sakta hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi karan film-studio aur naatak-ghar mein dry-ice fog sabse surakshit maana jaata hai. Exam point: stage fog = garam paani mein dry ice (solid CO2) ya glycol wali bhaap; ye zeherila nahi hai, isliye theatrical productions mein istemal hoti hai.

qe: Which iodine reagent turns intensely deep blue-black when tested on food containing starch?
qh: स्टार्च (मंड) की उपस्थिति का परीक्षण करने के लिए किस अभिकर्मक का उपयोग किया जाता है जो गहरा नीला-काला रंग देता है?
e: Lugol's iodine solution (I2/KI) mein jab iodine ko starch wale padarth par daala jaata hai to iodine aur starch milkar gehera neela-kaala (blue-black) rang deta hai - isliye ise aalu, chawal, aata jaisi cheezon mein starch jaanchne ke liye istemal karte hain. Fehling aur Benedict solution reducing sugar jaanchne ke liye hote hain (ye neele se eent jaise laal rang badalte hain), aur Biuret reagent protein ke saath jamuni (violet) rang deta hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Yaad rakhein: iodine ka ye rang iodine molecule ke starch ke helix ke andar fasne (clathrate) ke karan banta hai. Exam point: starch ki jaanch = Lugol's iodine solution (I2/KI), jo starch ke saath neela-kaala rang deta hai; Fehling/Benedict sugar ke liye aur Biuret protein ke liye hote hain.

qe: What chemical friction composition lines the striking strip on the exterior of a safety matchbox?
qh: सुरक्षा माचिस की डिब्बी के दोनों किनारों पर रगड़ने वाली सतह किसकी बनी होती है?
o: Red Phosphorus, powdered glass abrasive, and glue binder
e: Safety matchbox ke bahari kinare (striking strip) par laal phosphorus, barik kaanch ka churn (abrasive) aur glue lagaya jaata hai - match ki teeli ko is par ragadne se gharsh (friction) se paida hui urja laal phosphorus ki thodi maatra ko todkar teeli ke sire (head) ke potassium chlorate se kriya kar deti hai aur anch bhadak uthti hai. Kaanch ka churn gharsh badhane ke liye aur glue ise tikaye rakhne ke liye hota hai. Potassium chlorate aur antimony trisulfide teeli ke sire (head) par hote hain (kinare par nahi), safed phosphorus khatarnak hone ke karan chhod diya gaya, aur antimony trisulfide akele kaafi nahi - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: matchbox ke strip par = laal phosphorus + barik kaanch churn + glue; gharsh se laal phosphorus kriya karta hai aur teeli ke head (potassium chlorate + antimony trisulfide) se anch lagti hai.

qe: Which flammable gas is burned alongside pure Oxygen in metal cutting and oxy-fuel welding torches?
qh: धातुओं की वेल्डिंग और कटाई में ऑक्सीजन के साथ किस ज्वलनशील गैस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Dhatu kaate aur velde karne wale oxy-fuel torch mein acetylene (ethyne, C2H2) gas ko shudh oxygen ke saath jalaya jaata hai - is jod se lau ki taap lagbhag 3300 degree C tak pahunch jaati hai, jo dhaatu ko pighlaane ke liye kaafi hoti hai, isliye ise oxy-acetylene flame kehte hain. Propane, carbon monoxide ya methane ki lau isse kam garam hoti hai aur dhaatu kaatne ke liye upyukt nahi - Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: acetylene ko dabav mein le jaane ke liye acelene (acetone) mein ghula kar khaas cylinder bharti hai (kyunki wo shat ke dabav par ashiit hota hai). Exam point: dhaatu kaatne wale oxy-fuel torch mein = acetylene (ethyne, C2H2) jo shudh oxygen ke saath jal kar lagbhag 3300 degree C ki lau deta hai.

qe: Which foul-smelling organic sulfur compound is blended into commercial LPG cylinders as an odorant stenching agent?
qh: घरेलू एलपीजी में गैस रिसाव की पहचान के लिए दुर्गंधयुक्त किस सल्फर यौगिक को मिलाया जाता है?
e: LPG cylinder mein butane-propane gas ke saath ethyl mercaptan (ethanethiol, C2H5SH) milaya jaata hai kyunki LPG khud bina gandh ki gas hai - agar cylinder se leak ho to pata chalna mushkil ho jaata. Is sulfur wale padarth ki tej gandh se leak turant bhaanp li jaati hai, isliye ise 'odorant' ya 'stenching agent' kehte hain. Methyl alcohol, carbon disulfide ya hydrogen sulfide is kaam ke liye theek nahi (inmein se kuchh zyaada zeherile ya asaadharan hain) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi karan ghar mein gas ki gandh bhool kar bhi mahsus hona leak ka sanket maana jaata hai. Exam point: LPG mein leak pehchaanne ke liye milaya jane wala odorant = ethyl mercaptan (ethanethiol, C2H5SH); LPG khud bina gandh ki hai isliye odorant zaroori hai.

qe: What is culinary culinary 'Vinegar' chemically?
qh: घरेलू 'सिरका' (Vinegar) रासायनिक रूप से क्या होता है?
o: A 5% to 8% dilute aqueous solution of Acetic Acid ($CH_3COOH$)
e: Sirka (vinegar) acetic acid (ethanoic acid, CH3COOH) ka 5 se 8 pratishat paani wala tanu (dilute) ghulaimaan hota hai - yahi asaan bhaasha mein sirka hai aur yahi swaad aur parisarvan (preservative) ka kaam karta hai (achaar, chutney). Lactic acid dahi mein, citric acid neebu mein hota hai, aur '100% shudh glacial acetic acid' ek gaadha, khokhla-sheel rasayan hai jo khane ke liye bhaari padta hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: acetic acid ka shudh-sheel roop 'glacial acetic acid' kehlata hai jiska galaank lagbhag 17 degree C hai. Exam point: sirka = 5-8% acetic acid ka tanu ghulaimaan; lactic acid dahi mein aur citric acid neebu mein hota hai, isliye ye alag hain.

qe: What is the primary industrial application of 'Heavy Water' ($D_2O$)?
qh: 'भारी जल' ($D_2O$) का मुख्य औद्योगिक उपयोग क्या है?
o: Neutron Moderator and Coolant in nuclear fission reactors (PHWR)
e: Bhaari paani (Heavy Water, D2O) ka mukhya istemal parmaanu fisile bhatti mein neutron-sanchodhak (moderator) aur shitalak (coolant) ke roop mein hota hai - ismein deuterium (2H) hota hai jo neutronon ko kaafi dheema karta hai par unhe chhoti matara mein grahan nahi karta, isliye PHWR (pressurised heavy water reactor, jaise Canada ke CANDU aur Bharat ke reactor) mein iska istemal hota hai. Khad, paani ka khaniz poshak ya kapde ki safai (bleaching) ke liye ye istemal nahi hota - Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: D2O khane ke liye nahi hai, kyunki iski bhumika shaareerik paani ke metabolism par prabhav daalti hai. Exam point: heavy water (D2O) ka mukhya audyogik istemal = parmaanu reactor mein neutron moderator aur coolant (PHWR/CANDU), khad ya paani poshak ke liye nahi.

qe: What is 'Plaster of Paris' (POP) chemically?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से 'प्लास्टर ऑफ पेरिस' (POP) क्या है?
e: Plaster of Paris (POP) ka rasayanik naam calcium sulfate hemihydrate hai, jiska formula CaSO4.1/2 H2O hai - ise jipsum (CaSO4.2H2O) ko 373 K (100 degree C) par garam karke banaya jaata hai, jisse paani ka bhaag nikal jaata hai. Ise paani mein milane par ye punah jipsum ban kar sakht ho jaata hai (set karta hai), isliye haddi ka plaster, murti aur gudde banana is ka mukhya istemal hai. CaCO3 chuna-patthar, CaSO4.2H2O jipsum khud aur CaO chuna hai - isliye wo sahi jod nahi hain. Yaad rakhein: POP ka '1/2 paani' hi uski khaas pehchaan hai. Exam point: POP = calcium sulfate hemihydrate (CaSO4.1/2 H2O), jipsum ko 373 K par garam karne se banta hai; paani mein milte hi sakht ho jaata hai.

qe: What property of a liquid fuel is measured by its 'Flash Point'?
qh: किसी तरल ईंधन का 'फ्लैश पॉइंट' (Flash Point) क्या दर्शाता है?
o: The boiling point of the fuel
The temperature where the fuel freezes
The lowest temperature at which liquid vaporizes to form an ignitable mixture with air near the surface
The temperature where spontaneous self-ignition occurs without spark
e: Kisi drav indhan ka 'Flash Point' wo sabse kam tapman hota hai jis par us drav ki satah ke upar aisi bhaap ban jaaye jo hawa ke saath mil kar aag pakadne wala (ignitable) mishran banaye - yani ye indhan ki jalne ki suraksha (flammability) ka paimana hai. Isi liye petrol ka flash point kam (lagbhag -43 degree C) aur diesel ka zyada (lagbhag 52 degree C) hota hai, isliye diesel ko sambhalna (store) petrol se zyada surakshit maana jaata hai. Galaank (melting point), kraantik (freezing) ya swayam-jvalan (auto-ignition temp) alag gun hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: 'fire point' flash point se thoda upar hota hai jahan jwala tik jaati hai. Exam point: flash point = wo nyoonatam tap ke jahan drav indhan ki bhaap hawa mein aag pakadne wala mishran banaye; ye suraksha ka paimana hai (petrol ka kam, diesel ka zyada).

qe: What is the primary phosphatic chemical fertilizer manufactured by acidulating mineral rock phosphate with sulfuric acid?
qh: रॉक फॉस्फेट की सल्फ्यूरिक एसिड से अभिक्रिया कराकर बनाया जाने वाला प्राथमिक फॉस्फेटिक उर्वरक कौन सा है?
o: Single Superphosphate of Lime [SSP / $Ca(H_2PO_4)_2 \cdot H_2O + CaSO_4$]
e: Rock phosphate (khaniz) ko sulfuric acid ke saath kriya (acidulation) karke jo khad banta hai, wahi single superphosphate of lime (SSP) kehlata hai - ismein calcium di-hydrogen phosphate [Ca(H2PO4)2.H2O] aur jipsum (CaSO4) dono milte hain; ismein phosphorus lagbhag 16-18% P2O5 ke roop mein hota hai. Muriate of potash (MOP) potash wala khad hai, ammonium nitrate nitrogen wala, aur urea amid (ammonia se) banta hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Yaad rakhein: phosphatic khadon mein SSP, DAP aur TSP jaise 'superphosphate' bhi wahi vidhi (acidulation) se bante hain. Exam point: rock phosphate ko sulfuric acid se acidulate karke banta mukhya phosphatic khad = single superphosphate (SSP), jismein P2O5 ~16-18% hota hai.

qe: Which organic dicarboxylic acid is used in dry cleaning and laundry to bleach and solubilize insoluble iron rust stains?
qh: कपड़ों से लोहे के जंग के दाग हटाने के लिए किस कार्बनिक अम्ल का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Oxalic acid [(COOH)2] ek dicarboxylic acid hai jo loha ke zang (rust) aur saahii (ink) ke daagon ko kapdon se hataata hai kyunki ye loha (iron) ke saath ghulansheel samanvit (soluble complex) bana deta hai, jise paani se dhokar hata diya jaata hai. Acetic acid, formic acid aur malic acid se aisa gun nahi milta (inmein iron ke saath aise achhe complex banane ki kshamta kam hoti hai) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: oxalic acid safit (bleach) karne wala bhi hota hai, isliye rangdar kapdon par ise savdhani se istemal karna chahiye. Exam point: zang aur ink ke daag hatane wala dicarboxylic acid = oxalic acid [(COOH)2]; ye loha ke saath ghulansheel complex bana kar daag hataata hai.

qe: Which noble gas is filled in electronic stroboscopes, camera flash-bulbs, and ruby laser pumping tubes?
qh: हाई-स्पीड फोटोग्राफी, कैमरा फ्लैश और लेजर में किस अक्रिय गैस का उपयोग तीव्र सफेद प्रकाश के लिए होता है?
e: Xenon (Xe) mahan gas stroboscope, camera ke flash bulb aur ruby laser ke punah (pumping) tube mein istemal hoti hai kyunki bijli ke aav (discharge) se ye safed-chamkila tatha tez prakash deti hai aur apne gun khota nahi; isi liye high-intensity lamps aur car ke HID headlight mein bhi xenon bharta hai. Helium geubbe-ballon aur doping-gas ke liye, neon sign-board ke liye, aur radon (radioaktiv) vigyaan-anusandhan ke liye istemal hota hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Yaad rakhein: xenon ek bhaari, nishkriya gas hai jise saans ke saath lene par halka nasha bhi hota hai (anaesthetic roop mein istemal hua). Exam point: stroboscope, camera flash aur ruby laser pumping ke liye istemal honey wali mahan gas = xenon (Xe); neon sign-board aur helium balloon ke liye hai.

qe: What is the ultra-hard synthetic abrasive ceramic known industrially as 'Carborundum'?
qh: उद्योगों में अपघर्षक (Abrasive) के रूप में प्रयुक्त 'कार्बोरंडम' क्या है?
e: Bharat mein 'Carborundum' ke naam se mashhoor atyant kathor (ultra-hard) synthetic apgharshi (abrasive) silicon carbide (SiC) hai - ise ret (silica) aur coke ko bijli ki bhatti (electric arc furnace) mein 2000 degree C se adhik par garam karke banaya jaata hai; iski kathorta lagbhag 9 (mohs) hoti hai, isliye ise grinding wheel, khur (sandpaper) aur cutting tools mein istemal karte hain. Boron nitride, tungsten carbide aur calcium carbide anya padarth hain (boron nitride bhi kathor hai par Carborundum naam SiC ka hai, WC dhaatu-composite hai aur calcium carbide gas banata hai) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Carborundum = silicon carbide (SiC), atyant kathor synthetic abrasive; silica + coke ko bijli-bhatti mein garam karke banaya jaata hai (grinding wheel, khur ke liye).

qe: What is 'Bordeaux Mixture' traditionally sprayed in vineyards and orchards composed of?
qh: कृषि में बागवानी फसलों पर छिड़का जाने वाला 'बोर्डो मिश्रण' (Bordeaux Mixture) किन रसायनों का मिश्रण है?
o: Copper Sulfate ($CuSO_4$) and Slaked Lime [$Ca(OH)_2$] in water
e: Bordeaux mixture ek purana aur prabhavi fungicide (phaphund-nashak) hai jise copper sulfate (CuSO4) ke ghulaimaan ko bujhe chune [Ca(OH)2] ke saath milaakar paani mein banaya jaata hai - ise angoor (vineyards), seb aur anya phal ke baag-tatha alu jaisi fasalon par chhidka jaata hai; ye paudhon ki satah par ek suraksha-parat banata hai jisse fungus (phaphund) nahi ugta. Zinc oxide-namak, lead arsenate-sulfur ya potassium permanganate is khaas mishran ke ghatak nahi hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Yaad rahe: iska aavishkar Bordeaux (France) mein hua tha, isliye naam 'Bordeaux' pada. Exam point: Bordeaux mixture = copper sulfate (CuSO4) + slaked lime [Ca(OH)2] paani mein; ye ek surakshit fungicide hai jo bagh (vineyard) aur fasalon par chhida jaata hai.

qe: What is the primary gaseous fuel component of Compressed Natural Gas (CNG)?
qh: कंप्रेस्ड नेचुरल गैस (CNG) में मुख्य रूप से कौन सी हाइड्रोकार्बन गैस होती है?
e: CNG (Compressed Natural Gas) ka mukhya ghatak methane (CH4) gas hai jiski maatra lagbhag 85-95% hoti hai; ismein thodi maatra ethane, propane, butane aur nitrogen bhi hoti hai. Methane sabse halka hydrocarbon hai aur iska jalna saaf hota hai (kam dhuan, kam soot), isliye CNG ko petrol-diesel se safa indhan maana jaata hai aur Delhi aadi shehron mein bus-taxi mein istemal hota hai. Ethane, propane aur butane LPG ke ghatak hain, par CNG ka mukhya gas methane hi hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Yaad rakhein: CNG ko 200-250 bar dabav par cylinder mein bharta hai. Exam point: CNG ka mukhya ghatak = methane (CH4, lagbhag 85-95%); LPG ka mukhya ghatak butane-propane hai - dono alag indhan hain.

qe: Which transparent metal oxide coating is standard on smartphone capacitive touchscreens as a transparent conductor?
qh: स्मार्टफोन की टचस्क्रीन पर पारदर्शी विद्युत चालक के रूप में किस धातु ऑक्साइड का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Aadhunik smartphone ke capacitive touchscreen par ek paardarshi (transparent) aur vidyut-chaalak parat chadhi hoti hai, jiske liye indium tin oxide (ITO) istemal hota hai - indium oxide (In2O3) aur tin oxide (SnO2) ka ye mishran itna paardarshi hota hai ki ungli ke touch se bane vidyut parivartan ko bhaanp leta hai. Zinc ferrite, titanium dioxide aur aluminum oxide paardarshi hote hain par unmein itni achhi vidyut-chaalakta nahi hoti, isliye wo touchscreen ke liye sahi nahi - in teeno vikalpon ka istemal anya jagah (paint, sunscreen, ceramic) hota hai. Isi tarah ITO ka istemal solar cell aur LCD display mein bhi hota hai. Exam point: touchscreen ka paardarshi vidyut-chaalak (transparent conductor) = indium tin oxide (ITO); ye ungli ke touch se bane vidyut parivartan ko bhaanp leta hai.

qe: Which synthetic chemical explosive is designated RDX (Research Department Explosive / Cyclonite)?
qh: सैन्य विस्फोटक 'RDX' का रासायनिक नाम क्या है?
e: RDX ka poora naam cyclotrimethylenetrinitramine (ya cyclonite/hexogen, C3H6N6O6) hai - ye ek prabal dhamaaka padarth hai jiska istemal military bombs, torpedo aur mining mein hota hai; 'R' 'Research' aur 'D' 'Development' se aaya, isliye ise 'Research Department Explosive' bhi kehte hain. Trinitrotoluene (TNT), pentaerythritol tetranitrate (PETN) aur lead azide alag dhamaaka hain (TNT goli-bharne ke liye, PETN detonating cord ke liye, lead azide priming ke liye) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Yaad rakhein: RDX ki speed TNT se lagbhag 1.5 guna adhik hoti hai.
