Exam point: RDX = cyclotrimethylenetrinitramine (hexogen/cyclonite, C3H6N6O6), ek prabal military dhamaaka; TNT, PETN aur lead azide alag dhamaaka padarth hain.

qe: What is 'Turpentine Oil' added to exterior oil-based paints for?
qh: ऑयल-बेस्ड पेंट में 'तारपीन का तेल' (Turpentine Oil) किस उद्देश्य से मिलाया जाता है?
o: As a Paint Thinner and volatile solvent to reduce viscosity for brushing
e: Turpentine oil (chir-pine ke ped se nikalne wala tel) bahari oil-paint mein 'thinner' (patla karne wala) ke roop mein milaya jaata hai - ye tel paint ki sanvedansheelta (viscosity) kam kar deta hai jisse brush se paint aasaani se phailta hai aur jaldi sukh jaata hai. Ye rang ka pigment nahi hai, aag se bachaata nahi (khud jwala-sheel hai) aur paint ko paani mein ghulansheel nahi banata - isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Isi karan paint ki tin kholne par turpentine ki tej gandh aati hai; aaj mineral spirit (petroleum se bana thinner) bhi istemal hota hai. Exam point: turpentine oil = paint thinner/volatile solvent, jo oil-paint ko patla karke brush se lagane yogya banata hai; ye pigment ya fireproof agent nahi hai.

qe: What is 'Bagasse' obtained as a solid byproduct in sugar mills utilized for?
qh: चीनी मिलों से निकलने वाली गन्ने की खोई (Bagasse) का मुख्य उपयोग क्या है?
o: Boiler biofuel for power co-generation and raw pulp for Paper/Cardboard
e: Sugar mill (chini ki kolhu) mein ganna peesne ke baad jo sookhi avshesh (residue) bachti hai use bagasse kehte hain - iska mukhya upyog (1) bhatti (boiler) mein jala kar bhaap aur bijli paida karna (co-generation) hai, jisse mill ko bijli milti hai aur extra bijli grid ko di jaati hai, aur (2) isse kagaz, card-board aur particle board banane ke liye gooda (pulp) nikalna hai. Isse khane yogya gud (molasses) nahi milta (wo ganne ke ras se milta hai), na ye seedhe khad hai aur na ise concrete sakht karne ke liye istemal karte hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi liye chini-mill ko 'self-sufficient power' maana jaata hai. Exam point: bagasse = ganna peesne ke baad bacha sookha avshesh, jo bhatti keeendhan (power co-generation) aur kagaz-cardboard ke pulp ke liye istemal hota hai.

qe: What is the deep blue inorganic coordination pigment 'Prussian Blue' chemically?
qh: गहरे नीले रंग का अकार्बनिक वर्णक 'प्रशियन ब्लू' (Prussian Blue) रासायनिक रूप से क्या है?
e: Prussian Blue ka rasayanik naam ferric ferrocyanide [Fe4[Fe(CN)6]3] hai - ye ek gehra neela up-sanyojan (coordination) pigment hai jise iron ke lavan aur potassium ferrocyanide ke ghulaimaan ko milaakar banaya jaata hai; isi karan ye sasta aur sthir neela rang painting, saahii (ink), washing-blue aur chetri-karan (detection) mein istemal hota hai. Ultramarine, cobalt blue silicate aur copper carbonate anya neele pigment hain (inmein cobalt wala bahut mehnga hai) - par Prussian Blue ka sahi jod ferric ferrocyanide hi hai, kyunki ismein iron aur cyanide dono judte hain. Isi rang se Blueprint copy ki parampara bhi judi hai. Exam point: Prussian Blue = ferric ferrocyanide [Fe4[Fe(CN)6]3], gehra neela up-sanyojan pigment; ye paint, ink aur blueprint mein istemal hota hai.

qe: What is the commercial blasting explosive 'ANFO' widely used in open-cast coal mining?
qh: कोयला खदानों में उपयोग किया जाने वाला व्यावसायिक विस्फोटक 'ANFO' क्या है?
o: Ammonium Nitrate Fuel Oil (approx 94% ammonium nitrate + 6% fuel oil)
e: ANFO (Ammonium Nitrate Fuel Oil) ek aam audyogik dhamaaka (blast-explosive) hai jismein lagbhag 94% ammonium nitrate (khad wala padaarth) aur 6% fuel oil (diesel) milaya jaata hai - ye mishran sasta, surakshit aur aasaani se taiyaar hone wala hota hai, isliye khuli khaan (open-cast coal mining), patthar todi aur suraang mein sabse zyada istemal hota hai. Shudh nitroglycerin gel, acidified nitric fuel ya gunpowder pellets iske ghatak nahi (ye anya khatarnak ya purane dhamaaka hain) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: ANFO ko sirf ve dhamaaka karne wale takneek-mitra (blaster) hi istemal karte hain kyunki iske liye detonator zaroori hai. Exam point: ANFO = ammonium nitrate fuel oil (lagbhag 94% ammonium nitrate + 6% diesel/oil), sasta audyogik dhamaaka jo khuli khaan aur suraang mein istemal hota hai.

qe: What is industrial 'Red Lead' (Sindoor / Minium) primarily used for in civil construction?
qh: भारी निर्माण और जहाजों में 'रेड लेड' (सिंदूर / $Pb_3O_4$) का प्राथमिक औद्योगिक उपयोग क्या है?
o: Anti-corrosive primer paint to protect structural iron and steel from rusting
e: Industrial 'Red Lead' (sindoor/minium, Pb3O4) ka mukhya istemal loha aur steel ki satah par 'anti-corrosive primer' ke roop mein hota hai - ye dhaatu par ek parat bana kar paani aur oxygen ko rust (zang) ki kriya karne se rokta hai, isliye pul, pipeline aur loha ke tankon ki pehli parat mein yahi lagaya jaata hai. Cement ko sthir karna, farash ko keetanu-mukt karna ya kaanch ke darpan ko chaandi lagana iska kaam nahi - Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: sisa hone ke karan red lead seh-suraksha (lead poisoning) ke liye hanikarak hota hai, isliye ab iske safe vikalp istemal hote hain. Exam point: red lead (minium/sindoor, Pb3O4) = loha-steel ke liye anti-corrosive primer, jo zang rokta hai; cement, disinfectant ya mirror-silvering ke liye nahi.

qe: What is 'Gunpowder' (Black Powder) formulated from?
qh: पारंपरिक 'बारूद' (Gunpowder / Black Powder) किनका मिश्रण होता है?
e: Gunpowder (kaalaa barud) teen ghatakon ka mishran hota hai - potassium nitrate (saltpeter/shora, lagbhag 75%) okseedak (oxidiser) ke roop mein, charcoal (lakdi ka koyla, lagbhag 15%) indhan ke roop mein aur sulfur (lagbhag 10%) ko jaldi jalne aur kam tap par kriya karne ke liye. Isi santulan se barud jal kar dhuaan, garmi aur gas chhodta hai jo goli ya baroodgi (firework) ko dhakelta hai. TNT, lead azide ya nitroglycerin-clay aise mishran nahi hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Note karein: barud duniya ka sabse purana rasayanik dhamaaka hai jo 9veen sadi mein China mein aavishkar hua mana jaata hai. Exam point: gunpowder = potassium nitrate (75%) + charcoal (15%) + sulfur (10%); nitrate oxidiser, charcoal indhan aur sulfur jalaane wala ghatak hai.

qe: What is 'Titanium Dioxide' ($TiO_2$) universally utilized for across modern coatings and cosmetics?
qh: आधुनिक पेंट्स और टूथपेस्ट में 'टाइटेनियम डाइऑक्साइड' ($TiO_2$) का उपयोग किस रूप में किया जाता है?
o: High refractive index opaque White Pigment
e: Titanium dioxide (TiO2) ek uchch apvartan-ank (refractive index) wala safed pigment hai jo roshni ko bahut achhe se paravartit karta hai, isliye ye duniya ka sabse zyada utpadit safed pigment hai - paint, plastic, kagaz, khana (frooti-jaisa rang) aur sunscreen-cosmetics mein iska istemal hota hai (sunscreen mein ye UV kirnein bhi rokta hai). Ye kaalaa pigment nahi (kaala carbon black hota hai), anti-corrosive solvent ya fungicide bhi nahi - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi karan correction fluid (white-out) aur dant-manjan mein bhi TiO2 daala jaata hai, kyunki iski safed-dhakne ki chhamta sabse achhi hoti hai. Exam point: TiO2 = uchch apvartan-ank wala safed pigment (opacity sabse zyada), paint, cosmetics aur sunscreen mein istemal hota hai; kaala pigment carbon black hai.

qe: What is the chemical identity of 'Liquid Nitroglycerin' when stabilized with porous adsorbents for safety?
qh: तरल नाइट्रोग्लिसरीन को जब सुरक्षित हैंडलिंग के लिए स्थिर किया जाता है, तो क्या बनता है?
e: Liquid nitroglycerin ko sukhi-churn (porous) padarth (jaise kieselguhr/diatomaceous earth) mein sakh kar surakshit karne wala padarth 'dynamite' kehlata hai - ise 1867 mein Alfred Nobel ne banaya; is tarah nitroglycerin ki sanvedansheelta (shock par phatna) kam ho gayi aur use khade-khaano, suraang aur patthar todi mein kaam mein laana aasaani se sambhav hua. Gun cotton (nitrocellulose) aur TNT alag dhamaaka hain; 'plastic explosive' to aisa lodar (malleable) mishran hota hai jo nitroglycerin ko polymer ke saath milakar banata hai - isliye wo sahi jod nahi. Yaad rakhein: Isi aavishkar ne Nobel ko itni daulat aur prasiddhi di ki unhonne Nobel puraskar ki shuruat ki. Exam point: nitroglycerin ko porous sorbent mein sakh kar banaya surakshit dhamaaka = dynamite (Alfred Nobel, 1867); gun cotton, TNT aur plastic explosive alag padarth hain.

qe: What green inorganic oxide pigment is celebrated in ceramic glazes and industrial coatings for its exceptional UV and heat stability?
qh: पेंट्स और सिरेमिक में अत्यधिक स्थिर हरे रंग के लिए किस धातु ऑक्साइड वर्णक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Chromium(III) oxide (Cr2O3) 'chrome green' naam ka ek gehraa hara oxide pigment hai jo roshni (UV) aur garmi ke prati bahut sthir hota hai - isliye ye ceramic glazes, rang-aadi (paints) aur industrial coatings mein istemal hota hai; ye sabse sthir hara pigment maana jaata hai. Iron sulfide, nickel oxide ya copper carbonate anya rang de sakte hain par unki roshni-garmi sthirta is star ki nahi hoti (iron sulfide to oxidise ho kar rang badal deta hai) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi tarah green glass aur emerald jaise rang bhi Cr(III) se jude hain (jabki chromium ki +6 avastha zeherili hoti hai). Exam point: chrome green = chromium(III) oxide (Cr2O3), roshni aur garmi ke prati atyant sthir hara pigment; ceramic glaze aur coating mein istemal hota hai.

qe: Why can liquid elemental Mercury ($Hg$) be safely stored and shipped in industrial Iron/Steel flasks?
qh: तरल पारे (Mercury) को लोहे या स्टील के बर्तनों में सुरक्षित रूप से क्यों रखा जाता है?
o: Mercury does not form an amalgam with Iron
e: Para (mercury, Hg) ko loha ya steel ke botalon mein surakshit taur par bhar kar bheja ja sakta hai kyunki loha mercury ke saath 'amalgam' nahi banata - yani pighli hui para loha ki satah ko nahi khaati, isliye botal nahi kamzor hoti aur para bahar nahi behta. Sona, chaandi, zinc, copper jaise dhaatu mercury ke saath amalgam bana dete hain, isliye unke bartan mein para rakhna khatarnak hota hai. 'Iron sirf jal-bajat nahi hone deta', 'mercury doosri dhaatuon ko zang lagata hai' ya 'iron bhaap sokh leta hai' - ye teeno kathan vigyaan sammat nahi hain. Exam point: para (mercury) ko loha/steel ke bartanon mein bhar kar rakha jaata hai kyunki loha ke saath mercury amalgam nahi banata; sona-chaandi wale paatron mein rakhna khatarnak hai.

qe: Which metal salt gives a brilliant vivid 'Blue' emission color to fireworks pyrotechnic displays?
qh: आतिशबाजी और पटाखों में चमकदार 'नीला रंग' उत्पन्न करने के लिए किस धातु के यौगिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Fireworks mein hara rang barium (barium chloride ya nitrate) se, laal rang strontium, peela sodium aur neela rang copper ke lavan (jaise copper chloride) se milta hai - kyunki garam karne par ye dhaatu ke atom apne khone wale electron ki khaas urja-staar (energy level) ke hisaab se roshni chhodte hain, aur copper ki ye urja visheshata neele rang se milti hai. Isi karan 'neela rang' ke liye copper ke lavan istemal hote hain. Sodium peela, strontium laal aur barium hara rang deta hai - isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Yaad rakhein: neela rang banane mein sabse jyada kathinai hoti hai kyunki ucch tap par copper ke compound alag tarah vyavhaar karte hain. Exam point: fireworks mein neela rang = copper ke lavan (copper chloride); sodium peela, strontium laal aur barium hara rang deta hai.

qe: Which mineral acid is the ONLY chemical capable of dissolving silicon dioxide, making it standard for 'Etching Glass'?
qh: कांच पर नक्काशी (Etching) करने और उसे फ्रॉस्टेड बनाने के लिए किस एकमात्र अम्ल का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Sirf hydrofluoric acid (HF) hi silica (silicon dioxide, SiO2) ke saath kriya karke ghulansheel silikon tetrafluoride banata hai, isliye kaanch (jisme silica mukhya ghatak hai) ko khaakh (etch) karne ke liye yahi acid istemal hota hai - 'glass etching' mein isi se kaanch par naqsh (design) banaye jaate hain. Nitric, hydrochloric aur sulfuric acid silica par is tarah kriya nahi karte (wo alag dhaatuon ya anya padarthon par kaam karte hain) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: HF bahut khatarnak hai kyunki ye twacha aur haddi tak asar karta hai, isliye ise khaas plastic (Teflon) ke bartan mein hi rakha jaata hai (kaanch ki bottle mein nahi). Exam point: kaanch ko etch (khaakh) karne wala acid = hydrofluoric acid (HF); ye silica ke saath kriya karke ghulansheel fluoride banata hai (teflon ke bartan mein rakha jaata hai).

qe: What colorimetric redox reaction occurs inside traffic police Breathalyzers when alcohol vapor is exhaled into it?
qh: ट्रैफिक पुलिस द्वारा प्रयुक्त ब्रीथलाइज़र में श्वास की अल्कोहल किस रसायन को नारंगी से हरे रंग में बदल देती है?
o: Reduction of acidified Potassium Dichromate (Orange $Cr^{6+}$ to Green $Cr^{3+}$)
e: Breathalyzer mein acidified potassium dichromate (K2Cr2O7) ka ghulaimaan bhara hota hai - jab saans mein bhaap (alcohol vapour) aati hai to alcohol use okseed (oxidise) kar deta hai aur khud dichromate ka rang naranji (orange, Cr6+ avastha) se hara (green, Cr3+ avastha) ho jaata hai; rang badalne ki maatra se alcohol ki matara ka pata chal jaata hai. Phenol ka udasinikaran, silver chloride ka avkShepan ya copper sulfate ka okseedikaran is khaas test se jude nahi hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi rang-parivartan ko traffic police yantra mein alcohol ka pramaan maana jaata hai. Exam point: breathalyzer mein acidified potassium dichromate (K2Cr2O7) ka orange rang alcohol se green ho jaata hai (Cr6+ se Cr3+ apchayan), isi se alcohol jaanch hoti hai.

qe: What toxic chemical gas leak from the Union Carbide pesticide factory precipitated the 1984 Bhopal Gas Tragedy?
qh: 1984 की भोपाल गैस त्रासदी में यूनियन कार्बाइड की कीटनाशक फैक्ट्री से किस जहरीली गैस का रिसाव हुआ था?
e: 1984 ki Bhopal gas trajedi ke liye zimmedar gas Methyl Isocyanate (MIC, CH3NCO) thi - Bhopal ke Union Carbide ke keetnashak (pesticide) factory mein paani ghusne se MIC tank mein kriya hui aur bhooli gas hawa mein fail gayi, jisse hazaaron log maare gaye aur lakho beemar hue. Hydrogen cyanide, phosgene aur carbon monoxide alag zeherili gasen hain (MIC se banne wale kuchh products mein cyanide bhi hota hai, par seedhi zimevari MIC ki thi) - Ye vikalp galat hain. Is ghatna ke baad Bharat mein paryavaran sanrakshan kanun (Environment Protection Act, 1986) jaise kadi niyam laaye gaye. Exam point: Bhopal gas trajedi (1984) ki zeherili gas = Methyl Isocyanate (MIC, CH3NCO); Union Carbide ke keetnashak factory se ye gas hawa mein faili thi.

qe: What is the blended composition of the synthetic-natural fabric 'Tery-cot'?
qh: 'टेरी-कॉट' (Tery-cot) कपड़ा किन रेशों का एक लोकप्रिय मिश्रण है?
e: Tery-cot (Terylene + Cotton) ek mishrit (blended) kapda hai jismein polyester (Terylene) aur cotton dono ka mix hota hai - polyester kapde ko mazbooti, kam jhurriyan (crease-resistance) aur jaldi sukhne ka gun deta hai, aur cotton aaram, hawa ki aavajahi (breathability) aur pasine sokhne ka gun deta hai; isi liye tery-cot shirts-pant sabse aam istemal hota hai. Silk-wool, rayon-wool ya nylon-silk ke jodo mein ye dono gun ek saath nahi milte - Ye vikalp galat hain. Yaad rakhein: blended kapde ka maksad do alag fibers ke gun ek saath paana hai, isliye polyester-cotton ka jod sabse lokpriya hai. Exam point: Tery-cot = Terylene (polyester) + cotton; polyester se mazbooti aur cotton se aaram-pasina sokhne ka gun milta hai.
